ccaa9d0115dfd6af8e6b.title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
ccaa9d0115dfd6af8e6b.description:
**Job Title:** Recruiting Coordinator / Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist

**Location:** Remote (USA)

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (full-time) (W-2 or Contract or Contract-to-Hire)

**Required Technical Skills:**

* 2+ years coordinating recruiting, staffing, or high-volume professional scheduling
* Hands-on Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration and workflow management
* High-volume calendar management across multiple time zones using Google Workspace / Microsoft Outlook
* Offer letter assembly, reference check administration, and candidate onboarding logistics

**Preferred Technical Skills:**

* Experience in a Recruiting as a Service (RaaS) or agency/RPO environment
* Reporting and analytics via recruitment scorecards, SLAs, and pipeline metrics
  

  

**Employer Value Proposition:** Shape the future of talent acquisition within a modern Recruiting as a Service (RaaS) model. Enjoy total remote flexibility, zero reliance on placement fees, transparent performance metrics, and direct input into process design on an early, agile team.

Hiring fails in the gaps: slow replies, missed interviews, and messy status updates. As a Recruiting Coordinator, you will eliminate those friction points, ensuring every candidate and hiring team experiences a fast, clear, and high-touch hiring process. Operating at the center of our Recruiting as a Service (RaaS) model, you will bring structure, accountability, and seamless execution to diverse talent searches across technology, finance, healthcare, creative, and operations.

**Why You Should Join Us**

* **Modern Hiring Model:** Work in a Recruiting as a Service (RaaS) environment focused on quality and speed rather than transaction-based placement fees.
* **Process Ownership:** Play an active role in building and refining recruitment operations rather than just following rigid legacy playbooks.
* **Broad Exposure:** Manage workflows and touchpoints across a wide range of industries and professional functions.
* **Culture of Transparency:** Experience clear performance expectations measured through real metrics like time-to-slate and response rates.
  

  

**What You Will Do to Succeed**

* **Drive Calendar Execution:** Confirm interview requests within one business day, sending comprehensive prep notes and reminders to keep no-show rates near zero.
* **Own Candidate Touchpoints:** Manage candidate communications from first reach-out to offer acceptance, maintaining strict under-24-hour response windows on active searches.
* **Maintain Data Integrity:** Direct all ATS updates, stages, and notes so pipeline tracking and weekly reports are accurate and client-ready.
* **Manage Workflow Logistics:** Assemble offer letters, coordinate reference checks, and guide candidate onboarding logistics to ensure seamless conversions.
* **Monitor Pipeline Health:** Proactively identify scheduling bottlenecks, thin candidate slates, or stalled pipeline stages, collaborating with recruiters to resolve blockers immediately.
* **Track Operating Metrics:** Generate weekly performance scorecards tracking time-to-slate, interview completion rates, and candidate response speeds.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience in recruiting coordination, staffing operations, or high-volume scheduling.
* Advanced proficiency in managing Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and administrative workflows.
* Strong written communication skills with experience drafting clear updates for candidates and hiring managers.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple active searches concurrently while meeting strict same-day SLA turnaround times.
  

  

**How to Apply:** If you are ready to make hiring orderly, transparent, and efficient, submit your application along with a brief note highlighting one process you tightened and the tangible result it delivered.

By applying for this job, you agree that we can text you (standard rates apply).

By applying for this job, you agree that we can text you (standard rates apply).

3924407cef453c99c991.title: Telemedicine Coordinator
3924407cef453c99c991.description:
**Telemedicine Coordinator**

**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** W-2, Full-Time, Hourly  
**Compensation:** $30–$35 per hour, depending on experience

**Schedule:** Primarily Monday–Friday, with rotating weekend responsibilities approximately two weekends per month. Hours may vary based on operational needs. Candidates must maintain daytime availability for meetings and provider coordination and be able to accommodate meetings and operational needs across all U.S. time zones as necessary.

Weekend responsibilities include assigning providers to their designated facility shifts in Dialpad to help ensure consistent telemedicine coverage.

**Job Summary**

Telos Health Systems is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Telemedicine Coordinator to support our growing clinical operations and telemedicine programs.

This remote position plays an important role in coordinating provider scheduling, facility coverage, provider onboarding, education, communication systems, and daily operational workflows. The ideal candidate is technologically savvy, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

The successful candidate will work closely with clinical leadership, providers, onboarding staff, and other departments to promote efficient operations, accurate scheduling, and reliable telemedicine coverage across our clinical programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Telemedicine Operations & Communication Systems**

* Develop proficiency in Dialpad, our centralized communication and call-routing platform.
* Manage provider assignments within Dialpad, ensuring providers are assigned to their designated facility shifts.
* Serve as a primary backup for Dialpad management, including provider routing, coverage transitions, and troubleshooting.
* Support facility launches, provider assignments, and ongoing telemedicine workflows.
* Identify and help resolve communication, scheduling, and provider coverage issues.
* Maintain accurate provider assignments and support continuity of telemedicine operations, including during assigned weekend rotations.

**Provider Scheduling & Coordination**

* Maintain provider schedules, coverage calendars, staffing records, and operational trackers.
* Coordinate schedule changes, paid time off (PTO), call-outs, and replacement coverage.
* Proactively identify scheduling gaps and communicate updates to providers and clinical leadership.
* Support scheduling for Telemedicine, Telepsychiatry, and other clinical programs.
* Ensure provider schedules, facility-shift assignments, and coverage information remain accurate and up to date.
* Provide weekend scheduling and Dialpad assignment support approximately two weekends per month on a rotating basis.
* Coordinate meetings and operational activities across U.S. time zones as needed to support providers and clinical programs.

**Provider Onboarding & Education**

* Collaborate with onboarding staff and clinical leadership to support new provider orientation and readiness.
* Track onboarding requirements, system access, training completion, and outstanding items.
* Maintain and update learning management system (LMS) materials, assignments, and completion records.
* Assist with coordinating provider education, training sessions, and competency assessments.
* Help ensure providers have the information, resources, and system access needed to perform their responsibilities effectively.

**Administrative & Project Support**

* Assist with developing continuing medical education (CME) presentations, PowerPoint presentations, training guides, and educational resources.
* Create and maintain Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, schedules, reports, and operational trackers.
* Coordinate meetings, calendars, communications, project timelines, and follow-up tasks.
* Support new facility launches, clinical program expansions, and operational initiatives.
* Collaborate with clinical leadership and other departments to improve workflow efficiency and organization.
* Utilize approved AI and productivity tools to assist with document creation, presentations, and administrative tasks.
* Track outstanding tasks, follow up on action items, and help ensure deadlines are met.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Associate degree or higher in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Health Information Management, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn new software platforms quickly.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with clinical leadership, providers, and interdisciplinary teams.
* Strong problem-solving skills, reliability, and the ability to follow through on assignments with minimal supervision.
* Ability to maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and effective communication in a remote work environment.
* Availability during daytime business hours for meetings and provider coordination, with flexibility to accommodate operational needs.
* Ability to work across all U.S. time zones as necessary to support provider coordination, meetings, and telemedicine operations.
* Availability to participate in a rotating weekend schedule approximately two weekends per month.

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in healthcare administration, clinical operations, medical scheduling, provider coordination, or a related field.
* Experience with provider scheduling, telemedicine platforms, Dialpad, or learning management systems (LMS).
* Experience coordinating multiple projects, maintaining operational records, or supporting a distributed clinical team.
* Familiarity with approved AI-assisted productivity tools and technology to improve administrative efficiency.

**Benefits & Perks**

Telos Health Systems offers a benefits package designed to support work-life balance, professional development, and long-term growth.

**Available to All Employees (Part-Time & Full-Time)**

* Flexible work-life balance schedule.
* Company-provided equipment, including a Microsoft Surface Pro tablet with keyboard, case, stylus, and charger, as applicable to the role and company equipment policies.
* Telos swag.
* Mileage reimbursement in accordance with the company travel policy, including applicable minimum mileage thresholds.

**Professional Support**

* Opportunities to collaborate with clinical leadership and interdisciplinary teams.
* Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
* A supportive team environment focused on operational efficiency and quality clinical services.

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

Available to eligible full-time employees working at least 30 hours per week. Benefits become effective following a 30-day eligibility period, on the first of the month thereafter, subject to applicable plan terms.

**Health & Retirement**

* 401(k) retirement plan.
* Medical and prescription coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield.
* Dental insurance through UnitedHealthcare.
* Vision insurance through UnitedHealthcare.

**Voluntary Benefits (through Aflac)**

* Life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance.
* Short-term disability insurance.
* Accident insurance.
* Hospital indemnity coverage.
* Critical illness coverage.
* Voluntary life insurance, with term or whole life options.

**Time Off & Holidays**

* Paid Time Off (PTO): 15 days during the first and second years, with increases in subsequent years.
* Six paid holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

*Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan terms.*

**Why Join Telos Health Systems?**

At Telos Health Systems, we are committed to building an organized, collaborative, and supportive environment where team members can make a meaningful impact on clinical operations and patient care.

As part of our growing team, you will help support providers, strengthen telemedicine workflows, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to the continued expansion of our clinical programs. We value initiative, accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Telos Health Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and associates in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

6349afb56653bf11c750.title: CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator I
6349afb56653bf11c750.description:
The CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator provides administrative customer service assistance to claimants, providers, and claims management by scheduling ancillary healthcare appointments. Utilizing proprietary systems and knowledge from training, a CareIQ Scheduling Coordinator will provide excellent telephonic and written customer service to both inbound and outbound customers. This role operates with a high focus on accuracy and urgency to ensure that appointments are scheduled quickly in alignment with the claimant and customer needs.

This is a remote position.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Proactively monitors and manages files using proprietary web based applications.
* Identifies potential problems and trends, proposes solutions and ensures no delay in care.
* Provides telephonic and written customer support services.
* Documents actions and correspondence between parties.
* Ensures files are complete with all appropriate documentation.
* Utilizes CorVel Intranet and SharePoint to remain current of all policies and procedures.
* Requires regular and consistent attendance.
* Complies with all safety rules and regulations during work hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (IIPP).
* Additional duties as required.

  

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:**

* Effective multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet designated deadlines.
* Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Outlook and Excel.
* Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.

  

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required.

  

**PAY RANGE:**

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $15.61 - $23.82 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management (https://www.corvel.com/company/careers/)

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

  

**ABOUT CORVEL**

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

**CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.**

1f5d3ccd7cef4a85a081.title: Business Development & Proposal Coordinator
1f5d3ccd7cef4a85a081.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Business Development & Proposal Coordinator

**PROGRAM:** Business Operations

**LOCATION:** Remote; US-based only

**EMPLOYMENT:** Full-Time; 40 hours/week

**WORK AUTHORIZATION:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

**ABOUT US**

The Canton Group is a privately held, family-owned company with over 25 years of delivering award-winning websites, software, and digital modern secure solutions to Fortune 500 organizations and Government entities. We take immense pride in offering our employees the benefit of working fully remote while our Headquarters remain open in Baltimore, Maryland. The Canton Group’s presence spans across the nation – including our employees and clients – apply today and join us on our journey of growth!

**OUR CORE VALUES:**

Intellectually Curious | Committed to doing things the right way | Transparent, Honest, and Fair | Determined to delight our customers | Dedicated to Collaboration

**OVERVIEW:**

The Business Development & Proposal Coordinator is an early-career role supporting The Canton Group’s business development and proposal efforts. This role will help find new government and commercial opportunities, coordinate responses with our teaming partners, support proposal writing and submission, and keep our HubSpot CRM accurate and up to date. This is a great fit for someone who is organized, enjoys writing, and is genuinely excited about AI, including agentic tools like Claude that can research, draft, and carry out multi-step tasks.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

* Monitor procurement portals, bid boards, and other sources to identify new RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs; help qualify opportunities and prepare short recap summaries for leadership review.
* Coordinate proposal responses with teaming partners and subcontractors by scheduling meetings, requesting and tracking their inputs, and sharing status updates.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with teaming partners, subcontractors, and clients through regular check-ins, timely follow-up, and clear, professional communication.
* Help organize proposal responses, including building compliance matrices, outlines, and proposal schedules.
* Write and edit proposal sections such as company qualifications, past performance, staff resumes, and standard forms; help maintain a reusable content library.
* Format, assemble, and submit final proposal packages, ensuring all required forms, certifications, and attachments are complete and on time.
* Keep HubSpot up to date with opportunities, deal stages, partner and client contacts, deadlines, and submission outcomes.
* Use Claude and other AI tools daily to speed up research, RFP summaries, compliance matrices, first drafts, and content reuse, always reviewing output for accuracy and protecting confidential information.
* Help build agentic AI workflows, such as having Claude scan bid sources, pre-qualify opportunities, or update HubSpot records, and share ideas for improving how the team finds, writes, and tracks proposals.
* Manage the administrative side of business development, including teaming agreements, NDAs, vendor registrations, certifications, and other required paperwork, keeping records organized, current, and easy to find.
* Maintain version control and organized file structures so the team always works from the latest content.
* Help track proposal results and debrief feedback to improve future submissions.

  

**REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* 1–3 years of experience in proposal coordination, business development support, sales operations, technical writing, or a related role.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years’ experience in a related field (e.g., Business, Communications, English, Marketing, or IT).
* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills with close attention to detail.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools such as Claude for writing, research, or productivity, and enthusiasm for learning more.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines at once.
* Clear, professional communication with internal teams, partners, and clients.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Eagerness to learn government contracting, procurement processes, and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
* Adhere to the organization’s security policies, procedures, and controls to protect confidential information and ensure compliance with SOC 2 requirements.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Exposure to state, local, education (SLED) or federal government proposals.
* Experience setting up or using agentic AI tools that take multi-step actions autonomously (e.g., Claude with connected apps, custom agents, or automations).
* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM.
* Familiarity with procurement portals such as SAM.gov or state eProcurement systems.
* Experience with proposal management software or content management systems.
* Interest in pursuing APMP Foundation certification.

  

**BENEFITS:**

The Canton Group offers a competitive benefits package, including:

* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* Dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Paid sick time
* Holiday pay

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* May be required to work extended hours, if necessary, to meet proposal submission deadlines.

  

**AFFIRMATIVE ACTION/EEO STATEMENT:**

It is the policy of the Canton Group to provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. This policy relates to all phases of employment, including, but not limited to, recruiting, employment, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, reduction of workforce and termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation, selection for training, the use of all facilities, and participation in all company-sponsored employee activities. Provisions in applicable laws providing for bona fide occupational qualifications, business necessities or age limitations will be adhered to by the company where appropriate. As part of the company's equal employment opportunity policy, the Canton Group will also take affirmative action as called for by applicable laws and Executive Orders to ensure that minority group individuals, females, disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, other protected veterans, Armed Forces service medal veterans, and qualified disabled persons are introduced into our workforce and considered for promotional opportunities. Employees and applicants shall not be subjected to harassment, intimidation or any type of retaliation because they have (1) filed a complaint; (2) assisted or participated in an investigation, compliance review, hearing or any other activity related to the administration of any federal, state or local law requiring equal employment opportunity; (3) opposed any act or practice made unlawful by any federal, state or local law requiring equal opportunity; or (4) exercised any other legal right protected by federal, state or local law requiring equal opportunity. The above-mentioned policies shall be periodically brought to the attention of supervisors and shall be appropriately administered. It is the responsibility of each supervisor of the company to ensure affirmative implementation of these policies to avoid any discrimination in employment. All employees are expected to recognize these policies and cooperate with their implementation. Violation of these policies is a disciplinary offense.

29820cacc5c79b1b1a46.title: WHE - Operations Manager II
29820cacc5c79b1b1a46.description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The Operations Manager II is primarily responsible for management of the day to day operation of components of the program portfolio/department under the direction of the program/department Manager. These tasks may include management and reporting of staff and program/department performance, forecasting, reporting tracking and reporting of program/department metrics. The position is also responsible for establishing, execution, and reporting of all proactive quality assurance processes.
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.
  

* Manage and lead Operations team including Operations Analysts, Field Operations Auditors, Project Specialists, and Project Coordinators.
* Support delivery of operations team goals towards program and portfolio Key Performance Indicators
* Support and deliver payment reviews, application intake, customer service calls, and operations team scheduling
* Program/Project forecasting, tracking, invoicing, and reporting
* Oversight for weekly and monthly departmental/program reporting
* Work with the program teams to identify opportunities for process improvement that would improve customer/client satisfaction
* Work directly with internal functional teams and/or program teams on process and QA projects
* Ensure all documentation on contracts, SOWs, Cost Allocation Agreements, KPIs, etc. are up to date and readily available on SharePoint
* Support the organization of financial, legal, and budget tracking responsibilities in relation to portfolio programs compliance
* Manage and track the compliance requirements for contracts, addendums, proposals, and subcontracts for the portfolio
* Complete special ad-hoc projects and reporting for program, program manager, operations manager, and regional director
* Act as a technical resource/consultant to develop systems, processes, and process improvements for the portfolio
* Manage operations team staffing, budgets, goals, productivity, and provide analysis, solutions and recommendations on the operations team to Operations Manager and Regional Director
* Coordinate the internal support team efforts across the portfolio including reporting, meetings, leadership team coordination, and portfolio wide training and events
* Coordinate portfolio resource sharing inside and outside of the portfolio
* Work with internal customers to support the reporting needs of the portfolio, program, and business

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  
Education and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field from an accredited college or university.
* Previous operations experience including thorough understanding of energy efficiency or demand response program operations and processes
* 3+ years of progressive team management experience including managing and directing the work of direct reports and teams (preferred)

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Ability to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports and statements
* Ability to analyze program performance data and reports
* Proficient in data analysis and programmatic database management, ticketing, reporting, and dashboards
* Data entry skills in entering, tracking, maintaining, and querying databases
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to communicate to customers, clients, employees, and supervisor effectively
* Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical program problems
* Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide. Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages, and ratios
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Visio
* Ability to identify and resolve project, program, or application issues with customers, clients, trade allies, and internal stakeholders
* Exhibits concern for personal goal attainment, team goal attainment, and programmatic goal attainment
* Committed to diversity and inclusion
* Reliable transportation

Licenses & Certifications
  

* Valid driver’s license

**Compensation & Benefits:**  
Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $93,000.00 and $103,000.00 annually. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company-sponsored benefits and programs.
  
  
Travel Requirements
  

* Willingness to travel more than 60%

**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
  
The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position.
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
**Safety -Sensitive Role Addendum:**  
Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration.
  
  
**Notice Regarding Automated Tools:**  
We may use automated or AI-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

As a Recruiting Coordinator with the company, you will eliminate those friction points, ensuring every candidate and hiring team experiences a fast, clear, and high-touch hiring process. **About Nexplore**
==================

**www.nexploreusa.com**

Nexplore is a national enrichment service provider with a mission to foster the joy of learning through 125+ STEAM, Life Skills, and Fitness programs offered through after-school, in-school, summer camps, and other enrichment opportunities.

Currently, Nexplore proudly serves over 1,200 sites across 25+ U.S. states, providing thousands of students with engaging, hands-on learning experiences.

**Watch this video** to learn how Nexplore brings hands-on learning to life across schools nationwide through engaging programs, expert instructors, and our 5C Commitment.

**➕ Responsibilities Include, but Are Not Limited To:**

**Consistency – Program Operations & Execution**

* Oversee assigned enrichment programs to ensure successful implementation and consistent delivery.
* Monitor instructor schedules, attendance, punctuality, and overall program readiness.
* Ensure instructors are prepared with the necessary curriculum, materials, training, and site-specific expectations.
* Coordinate instructor coverage, schedule adjustments, and program changes to minimize disruptions.

* Monitor instructor performance and address concerns related to classroom management, instructional quality, professionalism, and site expectations.
* Collaborate with Curriculum, Training, Recruiting, and Operations teams to ensure instructors have the resources needed to succeed.
* Identify opportunities for instructor development and continuous program improvement.
* Ensure programs align with Nexplore's standards for high-quality enrichment experiences.

**Communication – School & Instructor Relationships**

* Build and maintain positive, professional relationships with school administrators, site coordinators, instructors, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide timely, clear, and proactive communication regarding schedules, program updates, instructor concerns, and operational changes.
* Respond to inquiries and resolve challenges with professionalism, urgency, and a solutions-oriented approach.

* Ensure all stakeholders remain informed and aligned throughout the program lifecycle.

**Creativity – Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Proactively identify operational challenges and develop effective solutions that support program success.
* Adapt to changing school schedules, staffing needs, and site-specific requirements.
* Collaborate with internal departments to improve processes, instructor experiences, and program delivery.

**Why Join Nexplore?**

This position offers the opportunity to:

Serving as the primary point of contact between Nexplore instructors, school partners, and internal teams, the Program Success Manager is responsible for overseeing daily program operations, supporting instructor success, maintaining strong relationships with school sites, and ensuring programs consistently meet Nexplore's quality standards.

6362d2f0cc6929d8bdaa.title: Admissions Coordinator
6362d2f0cc6929d8bdaa.description:
Our vision is a world of peaceful relationships with food, weight, and body image, where everyone with an eating disorder can experience recovery. We believe that exceptional, individualized care leads to lasting recovery from eating disorders. That's why our teams are comprised of compassionate, dedicated professionals from a variety of backgrounds who collaborate to provide the very best evidence-based care for our clients at all levels of care.

**Position Overview**

The Admissions Coordinator (AC) is accountable for providing an excellent customer experience by guiding clients through the pre-admission process post clinical assessment. The AC is a critical team member in the front-end admissions (enrollment) department. The position receives potential client referrals with level of care recommendations from the clinical intake team and works to convert those referrals to higher level of care admissions. ACs are responsible for ensuring beds and programming spots are filled to maximum possible occupancy. This position requires a heavy sales orientation and the ability to coordinate critical pre-admission appointments, and carry out complex administrative processes, while providing excellent communication and direction to clients and their families, internal staff, and external providers.

**Schedule**:

* 1.0 FTE, 40hrs/wk, working Monday through Friday approximately 10:30am to 7:00pm Central Time.

  

**Compensation Disclosure**

* Admissions Coordinator Starting Hourly Range: $25.00 - $31.25
* Eligible for quarterly performance bonuses totaling up to 30% of annual compensation
  

***Final Compensation offered will be within pay range based on qualifications/experience met for the position***

  

**How Administrative Coordinators Empower Recovery**

  

The position blends relationship-centered engagement with consultative communication and operational coordination in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment. The Admissions Coordinator guides individuals through the full admissions journey, from initial inquiry through admission placement, while helping reduce barriers to treatment and supporting client readiness for care.

Client Engagement & Conversion

* Serve as the primary contact for prospective clients, families, and referral sources via phone, email, and other communication channels.
* Guide clients and families through all stages of the admissions process with compassion, professionalism, urgency, and responsiveness.
* Engage clients using a compassionate, relational, and consultative approach to encourage movement through the admissions process.
* Conduct a pre-admit screen and share the recommended level of care as determined by a clinical team member.
* Effectively manage objections, assess readiness for change, and motivate clients to pursue treatment.
* Maintain conversion rates and registration targets by tailoring communication to client needs and stage of change.
* Provide clear, accurate information about treatment programs, admissions processes, and expectations.
* Share appropriate community resources when clients are unable to access care.
* Promptly answer incoming calls, including those through an admissions inquiry phone queue

Admissions Coordination & Scheduling

* Coordinate and schedule any pre-admission appointments (e.g., medical intake).
* Secure admission dates and ensure timely placement into appropriate levels of care (IP, Residential, PHP, IOP).
* Communicate confirmed admissions to internal teams.
* Provide clients with pre-admission materials (e.g. program handbooks and addendums) and share health insurance benefit quotes for recommended services.
* Conduct routine follow-ups with prospective clients.

Census Management

* Support organizational census goals by facilitating timely and appropriate admissions across levels of care.
* Monitor program capacity and collaborate with operational and clinical teams to optimize admissions placement opportunities.
* Track client progression throughout the admissions pipeline and maintain accurate status updates within internal systems.
* Escalate census concerns, admission delays, or placement barriers as appropriate.

Documentation & Systems Management

* Accurately create, maintain, and update client records in the CRM, EHR, and other internal systems.
* Maintain timely and detailed documentation of all client interactions, follow-up activities, and admissions-related communications in the CRM.
* Ensure all records, documentation, and workflows meet quality assurance, compliance, HIPAA, and organizational standards.
* Utilize internal tracking tools and reporting systems to support operational visibility and workflow management.
* Maintain accuracy and attention to detail while managing high-volume documentation responsibilities.

Relationship Management & Support

* Build and maintain strong relationships with referring providers and internal teams.
* Provide support for escalated or sensitive client interactions with professionalism and empathy.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure a seamless admissions experience.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of protected health information in accordance with regulations and company policies.

General Duties

* Balance a fast-paced, results-driven environment with compassionate client interactions.
* Adapt to changing priorities while maintaining performance standards.
* Provide team support and coverage (e.g. PTO coverage) as needed or assigned.
* Adhere to time management policies and procedures (e.g. on/off queue procedures, break schedules, etc.)
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

Professional Qualifications:

* 1–3+ years of experience in healthcare admissions, intake coordination, healthcare sales, or related client-facing role required.
* Experience in behavioral health, eating disorder treatment, healthcare sales, or high-volume call center environments preferred.
* Sales/customer service experience preferred.
* Experience working directly with clients, families, or patients in emotionally sensitive situations strongly preferred.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and workflows in a fast-paced environment preferred.
* Familiarity with insurance verification, healthcare scheduling, or admissions processes preferred.

**What we offer:**

**Employee Benefits:** We understand the importance of a well-rounded benefits package. That's why we're dedicated to providing a range of plans to meet your needs.

For full-time employees, we offer:

* HSA and PPO insurance with HSA or FSA options (Blue Cross Blue Shield)
* Dental insurance (Delta Dental)
* Vision insurance (EyeMed)
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance
* Company-paid life insurance
* 401(k) plan available two months after start date
* Company 401(k) matching for up to 50% of your contribution, up to 6% of your compensation

Paid time off is a crucial part of maintaining work and life balance. Our generous PTO plan accrues annually and begins with your first whole pay period. Eligible employees enjoy seven paid holidays and one floating holiday in addition to their regular PTO.

* Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods of time.
* Ability to communicate clearly by phone, email, and in person.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Occasional lifting of office supplies or equipment up to 25 lbs.

**Join Our Team at Skin and Cancer Institute!**

Are you passionate about dermatology and skin health? Do you thrive in a dynamic, patient-focused environment? Skin and Cancer Institute is looking for dedicated professionals to join our team!

**Why Join Us?**

At Skin and Cancer Institute, we are committed to excellence in dermatology, skin cancer treatment, and cosmetic procedures. We offer a supportive and collaborative work culture where your skills and dedication make a real impact.

**Summary of Position**

* Work Location: **US Remote**
* Work Category: **Non-exempt, Full-time/Regular, On-site**
* Work Schedule: **Mon-Fri between 7AM-6PM PST (maximum of 40 hours per week)**

The **Call Center Agent** serves as the primary point of contact for patients of the Skin and Cancer Institute, delivering exceptional customer service and managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls related to appointment scheduling, patient inquiries, referrals, insurance verification, prescription requests, and other care coordination activities.

This role requires mastery of company services, locations, marketing campaigns, and salesmanship to achieve a 95% call completion rate using effective and ethical sales techniques. Agents must complete initial and ongoing training to stay current with operational updates, service offerings, and organizational procedures.

The ideal candidate possesses strong healthcare customer service experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced medical environment. The Call Center Agent ensures patients receive timely access to dermatology and oncology services while maintaining compliance with HIPAA regulations and organizational standards.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

**Patient Communication & Customer Service**

* Serve as the first point of contact for patients contacting the Skin and Cancer Institute via telephone and other communication channels.
* Answer a high volume of inbound calls in a professional, courteous, empathetic, and efficient manner.
* Provide exceptional customer service while addressing patient inquiries, concerns, and requests.
* Demonstrate mastery of knowledge related to company services, locations, marketing campaigns, and salesmanship to ensure 95% call completion for patients using effective and ethical sales techniques.
* Resolve patient issues and escalate complex concerns to the appropriate department or supervisor when necessary.
* Maintain a patient-centered approach during all interactions to ensure a positive patient experience.

**Appointment Scheduling & Patient Access**

* Schedule, reschedule, cancel, and confirm patient appointments in accordance with provider schedules and clinic protocols.
* Coordinate new patient appointments, follow-up visits, procedures, and annual recall appointments.
* Identify appropriate appointment types and provider availability based on patient needs and clinical guidelines.
* Conduct outbound calls for appointment reminders, recalls, waitlist management, and patient outreach campaigns.
* Assist patients in locating convenient clinic locations and providers within the organization.

**Patient Registration & Insurance Support**

* Verify and update patient demographic information within the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
* Collect and validate insurance information to support accurate patient registration and eligibility verification.
* Assist patients with questions regarding referrals, authorizations, insurance requirements, and appointment prerequisites.
* Ensure all patient information is entered accurately and completely to minimize registration and billing errors.

**Care Coordination & Clinical Support**

* Route patient messages, medical concerns, prescription refill requests, and provider communications to the appropriate clinical staff.
* Coordinate referrals, consult requests, and follow-up care activities as directed.
* Support continuity of care by facilitating communication among patients, providers, medical assistants, and administrative staff.
* Assist with patient outreach initiatives, preventive care campaigns, and treatment follow-up programs.

**Documentation & Data Management**

* Accurately document all patient interactions, appointment activities, and communication notes within the EMR and call management systems.
* Maintain complete, timely, and accurate records in accordance with organizational policies and healthcare regulations.
* Review and update patient records to ensure information integrity and continuity of care.

**Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Adhere to HIPAA regulations and always maintain the confidentiality and security of patient information.
* Follow all Skin and Cancer Institute policies, procedures, and service standards.
* Meet established call quality, productivity, attendance, and performance standards.
* Participate in quality assurance reviews, coaching sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Team Collaboration & Professional Development**

* Collaborate effectively with providers, clinic staff, leadership, and other departments to ensure efficient operations and exceptional patient care.
* Successfully complete initial and ongoing training programs to remain current with operational updates, service offerings, and organizational standards and organization-wide initiatives.
* Maintain knowledge of dermatology services, provider specialties, scheduling protocols, insurance requirements, and organizational updates.
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**

**Required Skills / Abilities**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service orientation and ability to build rapport with patients.
* Knowledge of healthcare scheduling workflows and medical office operations.
* Understanding of HIPAA regulations and patient confidentiality requirements.
* Experience handling high-volume call queues in a call center or healthcare environment.
* Ability to multi-task while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR/EHR) systems.
* Ability to navigate multiple software applications simultaneously.
* Working knowledge of medical terminology, insurance plans, referrals, and authorizations.
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Professional demeanor with a patient-centered approach to service.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and a fast-paced work environment.

Preferred:

Description:

Soleo Health is seeking an **Infusion Clinical Review Coordinator** to support our Specialty Infusion Pharmacy and work **Remotely (USA)**. Join us in Simplifying Complex Care! **Must be able to work Monday-Friday, 8:30am - 5pm MST or PST**

**Specialty Infusion Pharmacy experience is required**

**Soleo Health Perks:**

* Competitive Wages
* Flexible schedules
* 401(k) with a match
* Referral Bonus
* Paid Time Off
* Annual Merit Based Increases
* No Weekends or Holidays
* Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans
* Company Paid Disability and Basic Life Insurance
* HSA and FSA (including dependent care) options
* Education Assistant Program

**The Position:**

The Infusion Clinical Review Coordinator works closely with all departments to research and provide accurate and timely clinical review on complex, patient cases to ensure that approval is secured and to mitigate risk of technical and clinical denials. The Clinical Review Coordinator attempts to resolve denials by utilizing nationally recognized criteria for appeal submission.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Completes prior authorization reviews in a timely manner through their clinical expertise evaluating patient clinicals and payer clinical criteria to determine if the service meets medical necessity of the payer
* Reviews and comprehends patient progress notes, lab reports, infusion summaries, imaging reports, and plan of care. Identifies appropriate medical documentation that satisfies payer medical policy criteria
* Request additional clinical information when needed to render a decision and/or determine next steps
* Assists with creation of clinical support packets to be used for the initial prior authorization and/or subsequent appeals
* In cases of authorization denials, constructs and documents a succinct and fact-based clinical case to support appeal utilizing appropriate medical necessity criteria and other pertinent clinical facts
* Creates and maintains, a library of clinical support resources to include templates for appeals, journal articles, other reference tools that can be used to support medical necessity. When existing resources are unavailable search for supporting clinical evidence to support appeals
* Provides program support by staying current on the top payer covered services, medical necessity requirements and formulary details. Also, must be proficient in locating payer resources related to medical policies
* Assist with post service insurance denials & appeals
* Participates in outcome programs including but not limited to data entry, reporting functions, and patient calls with necessary to complete denial support tasks
* Provides inter-departmental training to increase teams’ knowledge for top disease states and specialty drugs, clinical requirements, and prior authorization & appeal best practices

**Schedule:**

* **Must be able to work Remote, Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5pm Mountain or Pacific time**
* **Must have experience with denial support, clinical reviews, and appeals for infusions and specialty pharmacy**

Requirements:

* **Preferred qualifications are Medical Assistant, LPN, RN**
* **Experience with specialty infusion pharmacy required**
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare field or 3 years in a qualified position
* Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and presentation), excellent customer service and interpersonal skills
* Flexible communication style, highly motivated team player with excellent listening skills
* Able to handle stress to meet identified program objectives and manages time effectively
* Self-starter that takes responsibility, is comfortable with accountability and results oriented
* Competent in the use of Word, Excel, and Power Point
* Must be able to communicate effectively with all levels of organization within Soleo Health
* Must enthusiastically support Soleo Health’s philosophy and goals

**About Us:**

Soleo Health is an innovative national provider of complex specialty pharmacy and infusion services, administered in the home or at alternate sites of care. Our goal is to attract and retain the best and brightest as our employees are our greatest asset. Experience the Soleo Health Difference!

**Soleo’s Core Values:**

* Improve patients’ lives every day
* Be passionate in everything you do
* Encourage unlimited ideas and creative thinking
* Make decisions as if you own the company
* Do the right thing
* Have fun!

Soleo Health is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We recognize that establishing and maintaining a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is the foundation of business success and innovation. We are dedicated to hiring diverse talent and to ensuring that everyone is treated with respect and provided an equal opportunity to thrive. Our commitment to these values is evidenced by our diverse executive team, policies, and workplace culture.

Soleo Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer, celebrating diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Soleo Health does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an organization, parental status, military service or other non-merit factor.

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Alvarez & Marsal is seeking a dynamic, enthusiastic Executive Assistant (EA) to join its North American Data and AI team. This group is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. **This is a hybrid position based in our New York City office, with an in-office expectation of two days per week.**

Our EAs are made up of a team of experienced professionals who support our top executives and teams across the globe. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who enable our teams to deliver gold standard work to our clients. The candidate should be motivated, resourceful, organized, poised, and able to operate independently with strong attention to detail.

**How you will contribute**

* Provide high-level administrative and executive support to the North American Data and AI group Managing Directors in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
* Manage complex internal and client calendars, coordinating across multiple executives, clients, stakeholders, and time zones while navigating frequent changes and competing priorities.
* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, detailed itineraries, and last-minute changes.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including client meetings, leadership meetings, team meetings, off-sites, and one-on-one meetings, managing all associated logistics for both in-person and virtual settings.
* Process time and expense reports using Concur and provide ongoing administrative support to Managing Directors.
* Serve as a professional point of contact for clients, senior executives, and internal stakeholders, ensuring responsive and seamless communication.
* Train and support new hires as needed on administrative processes, systems, and team procedures.
* Perform Excel analysis as required, including event and vendor contract comparisons.
* Provide proactive support on special projects and evolving business needs, anticipating priorities and ensuring strong follow-through.
* Additional duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years Executive Assistant / Business Operations Experience
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred
* Outstanding customer service / interpersonal skills; ability to support multiple executives / varied working styles.
* Strong relationship management skills, ability to build a personal network throughout the company as a trusted team member.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders and external partners.
* Ability to ensure communications are clear, thorough, and specific, with attention to follow-through and confidentiality.
* Excellent computer and calendaring skills to include a working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Salesforce, Concur, file sharing software (i.e., Box).
* Skillful execution of administrative activities, with high attention to detail, organization and process; consistently produce error-free work; Organized and detail orientated with excellent follow through; independent.
* Strong problem-solver.
* Self-motivated, tactful, and a great team player.
* Professional image and demeanor.
* Project coordination and management experience needed at an intermediate complexity.
* Proven ability to manage projects, work under pressure with minimal direction and consistently make deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously acquire new competencies and accept new challenges.

**Your journey at A&M**

The Patient Communications Specialist serves as a primary point of contact for incoming communications, managing high-volume calls, routing calls and messages, providing approved information, and supporting basic scheduling needs in accordance with established protocols and patient service standards.

----------------------------

* Answer a high volume of incoming calls in a timely, courteous, and professional manner.

Process Management, Written Communication, Negotiation Skills, Presentation Skills, Collaboration, Self-Motivated, Team Player, Strategic Thinker, Leader, Self-Starter, Listener, Advisor, Problem Solver.

**Position Overview**

The Logistics Coordinator & Order Processor is responsible for accurate ecommerce order processing, shipment verification, and inbound and outbound freight coordination. This position ensures orders are properly entered into QuickBooks and ShipStation, communicated to the appropriate branch, and followed through until shipment is confirmed.

The role combines order processing and logistics responsibilities, with a primary focus on preventing missed orders, maintaining inventory accuracy, meeting customer delivery expectations, and controlling freight costs.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities while taking ownership of tasks from beginning to completion. This position works closely with customers, branch teams, managers, Sales, Accounting, Marketing, and transportation providers.

**Work Schedule, Flexibility & Time Off**

This is a fully remote, salaried position built around flexibility, independence, and accountability.

We don't believe in watching the clock or requiring someone to sit at a desk from 9 to 5. We care about results. You'll have the freedom to manage your own schedule, provided you're accessible when needed, shipments are moving, and your responsibilities are handled.

We don't have a traditional PTO accrual system for this position. Instead, we offer flexible paid time away. Need a vacation, a long weekend, or an afternoon off? That's fine. Your salary continues as normal, provided you communicate your plans, arrange appropriate coverage when necessary, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

In return for that flexibility, we expect ownership. Freight doesn't always operate on a convenient schedule, and occasionally situations require attention outside traditional business hours.

**The bottom line: We give you the freedom to manage your time, and we trust you to manage the work.**

**Primary Responsibilities**

**1. Order Processing & Ecommerce Management**

* Accurately and promptly process ecommerce purchases in QuickBooks and ShipStation.
* Verify order details, pricing, quantities, customer information, and shipping instructions.
* Ensure transactions are entered correctly to support accurate inventory accounting and order fulfillment.
* Communicate order information to the appropriate branch and internal teams.
* Monitor incoming orders and ensure they are processed within established timeframes.
* Identify and report potentially fraudulent transactions, suspicious orders, website glitches, and inaccurate order information.
* Coordinate with Sales, Accounting, and Marketing to resolve order discrepancies and ecommerce-related issues.
* Maintain accurate records and promptly communicate any issues that could delay fulfillment.

**2. Shipment Verification & Follow-Through**

* Verify that orders and shipping requests are received from Sales or the appropriate originating department.
* Confirm that the responsible branch receives and acknowledges order instructions.
* Track orders through fulfillment and verify that shipments are actually picked up or dispatched.
* Follow up on orders that have not been received, acknowledged, processed, or shipped.
* Maintain a reliable order tracking system that identifies outstanding orders, responsible parties, and current status.
* Ensure bills of lading, tracking information, shipping labels, and other required documentation are completed accurately.
* Investigate missing orders, delayed shipments, incomplete documentation, and discrepancies between order records and actual shipments.
* Escalate unresolved issues to management before they result in missed shipments or customer complaints.

**3. Freight Coordination & Cost Savings**

* Coordinate inbound and outbound freight, including less-than-truckload (LTL), full truckload (FTL), and other transportation methods.
* Obtain, compare, and negotiate freight quotes to secure competitive shipping rates.
* Schedule pickups and deliveries with carriers, customers, and branch locations.
* Select transportation options based on cost, delivery timelines, shipment dimensions, weight, packaging, and handling requirements.
* Track shipments and communicate delays, missed pickups, and delivery changes.
* Review freight invoices against quoted rates and identify unexpected fees, billing discrepancies, and opportunities for savings.
* Maintain relationships with carriers and transportation providers.
* Verify that branches have the information necessary to safely load and unload shipments.
* Maintain organized records of freight quotes, shipping costs, carrier performance, and transportation issues.

**4. Communication & Customer Service**

* Maintain effective communication with customers, Sales, branch teams, managers, Accounting, Marketing, and carriers.
* Provide timely updates regarding order status, shipping arrangements, tracking information, and delays.
* Resolve order and shipping issues professionally and efficiently.
* Ensure relevant team members are informed of outstanding orders and potential fulfillment delays.
* Maintain a customer-focused approach while balancing shipping deadlines, operational requirements, and cost control.

**5. Process Improvement & Administrative Support**

* Identify opportunities to improve order accuracy, shipment visibility, transportation efficiency, and internal communication.
* Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures for order processing, freight quoting, shipment tracking, and verification.
* Maintain accurate order, freight, and shipping documentation.
* Assist with reporting on outstanding orders, shipping performance, freight costs, and recurring operational issues.
* Recommend solutions that reduce errors, improve accountability, and prevent orders from falling through the cracks.
* Support additional Operations projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Previous experience in logistics, freight coordination, order processing, ecommerce, shipping, or warehouse operations required.
* Experience with QuickBooks, ShipStation, or similar order management and shipping platforms required.
* Knowledge of LTL and FTL shipping processes is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, email, and general business software.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple orders and shipments.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and follow tasks through completion.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and branch locations.

Pay: $40,000.00 - $45,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

**About iMPROve Health**

**Come join the iMPROve Health team!**

iMPROve Health is Michigan’s Medicare-designated Quality Improvement Organization, and we’re proud to be recognized as both a *Cool Place to Work* by Crain’s Detroit Business (four years running) and one of *Modern Healthcare’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare*.

As a nonprofit with more than 40 years of experience, we’re dedicated to improving healthcare across the continuum of care using evidence-based, data-driven strategies. We provide medical consulting and review services, along with data analysis, to federal agencies, state Medicaid programs, public health organizations, healthcare facilities, private health plans, and other third-party payers. Our team also specializes in impartial utilization review, dispute resolution, and peer review. Our mission is simple: help healthcare get better.

This position is 100% remote, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States while collaborating with a supportive, nationwide team. We prioritize work/life balance and invest in our employees’ growth through professional development and continuing education opportunities.

At iMPROve Health, we are committed to improving the quality, safety, and efficiency of healthcare. While we do not provide direct patient care, our healthcare professionals—including physicians, nurses, and experienced consultants—partner with providers to promote the use of evidence-based best practices. We offer our clients a trusted, impartial resource that understands the complexities of the healthcare landscape and is dedicated to thoughtful, high-quality solutions.

Join us in making a meaningful impact on healthcare—one improvement at a time.

**Payment Determinations Coordinator | Fully Remote**

**About the Role**

iMPROve Health is seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and experienced Payment Determinations Coordinator to support our Federal and State Independent Dispute Resolution Entity (IDRE) programs under the No Surprises Act (NSA).

In this role, you will coordinate payment determination activities, manage dispute cases and program deadlines, maintain accurate case records, and support compliance with applicable Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) requirements and contractual obligations. You will work closely with arbitrators, program managers, and organizational leadership to facilitate timely, accurate, and consistent case processing.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of the Federal No Surprises Act, excellent project and time management skills, and the ability to navigate multiple electronic systems while managing competing priorities in a fully remote environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Payment Determinations and Case Management**

* Coordinate dispute cases throughout the case lifecycle, from intake through final resolution.
* Review case submissions for completeness, accuracy, eligibility, and compliance with applicable program requirements.
* Coordinate case assignments to arbitrators, reviewers, and other appropriate decision-makers.
* Complete payment determination processing following arbitrator review in accordance with established procedures and program requirements.
* Monitor case status, deadlines, and outstanding activities to ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate case information, documentation, and communications in CMS portals and internal databases.
* Respond to arbitrator inquiries and provide procedural guidance regarding case requirements and workflows.

**Program Operations and Compliance**

* Complete assigned contract deliverables and operational activities within established timelines.
* Monitor work plans, schedules, and case-processing activities to identify potential delays, risks, or operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with applicable CMS requirements, HIPAA, FISMA, URAC standards, contractual obligations, and internal policies.
* Conduct quality reviews to promote accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify discrepancies, compliance concerns, and opportunities for process improvement, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Assist with the implementation and enhancement of operational systems, tools, and workflows.

**Training and Documentation**

* Develop, update, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), job aids, templates, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and other operational resources.
* Develop and deliver onboarding and ongoing training related to IDRE workflows, CMS portal navigation, documentation standards, and communication protocols.
* Collaborate with program managers and leadership to ensure training materials reflect current regulatory guidance, contractual requirements, and internal policies.
* Conduct refresher training and assist in identifying knowledge gaps and additional training needs.
* Communicate process changes and updates to affected team members.

**Communication and Collaboration**

* Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders, including arbitrators, providers, payers, legal representatives, and other dispute resolution participants.
* Serve as a point of contact for procedural questions, submission requirements, and case status inquiries.
* Maintain neutral, professional, and clear communication throughout the dispute resolution process.
* Collaborate with operations, compliance, legal, finance, IT, and other teams to resolve issues and support program objectives.
* Participate in meetings concerning operational priorities, escalations, stakeholder feedback, and policy updates.

**Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare operational reports related to case volume, resolution outcomes, turnaround times, outreach activities, and performance metrics.
* Maintain spreadsheets, tracking tools, and dashboards to monitor service levels, response times, case aging, and operational trends.
* Analyze operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.
* Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare-related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least five years of project support experience in a corporate or professional environment, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
* Knowledge of the Federal No Surprises Act.
* Strong organizational, project management, and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, reliability, accountability, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, Windows-based software, and web-based portals.
* Experience developing and maintaining moderately complex spreadsheets.
* Ability to navigate multiple electronic systems and cloud-based platforms while maintaining accurate records and data integrity.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a healthcare-related or relevant field.
* Familiarity with healthcare billing, reimbursement, and payer-provider processes.
* Experience reviewing medical claims, remittance advice, and Explanation of Benefits (EOBs).
* Understanding of quality improvement concepts.
* Experience developing training materials, SOPs, and operational documentation.
* Experience supporting portal development, system enhancements, or workflow improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with CMS portals, Salesforce, and other third-party platforms.

**Remote Work Requirements**

This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be able to:

* Maintain a reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for business applications and virtual communications.
* Maintain a private, secure, professional, and distraction-free workspace.
* Protect confidential information, including protected health information (PHI), in accordance with HIPAA, FISMA, URAC, CMS, and organizational requirements.
* Work independently, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet established deadlines.
* Maintain regular availability and communication during scheduled work hours.
* Effectively collaborate through virtual meetings, approved communication tools, and electronic systems.

**Why Join iMPROve Health?**

Join a team dedicated to healthcare quality, regulatory compliance, and effective dispute resolution. In this role, you will contribute to important healthcare operations while collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across a fully remote organization.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

The Operations Delivery Specialist is responsible for overseeing end-to-end execution, procurement, and fulfillment for operational and project-specific requests. This role acts as a primary operational nexus, ensuring that goods and materials are sourced, allocated, transferred through regional distribution hubs, and delivered strictly within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Operating in a high-tempo environment, the incumbent must demonstrate sound judgement, rigorous inventory oversight, effective escalation management, and seamless cross-functional coordination.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Lifecycle Request & Fulfillment Execution**

* Direct the end-to-end lifecycle of project-specific requests, ensuring complete alignment with agreed schedules and operational criteria.
* Facilitate target procurement and vendor sourcing required to satisfy complex project material demands.
* Coordinate inter-hub stock transfers, monitoring specialized packing protocols, regional transport schedules, and final-mile delivery verification.
* Maintain high-touch communication protocols to inform stakeholders of delivery milestones and lead-time projections.

**Escalation Management &** **Resolution**

* Act as the direct point of contact for operational disruptions, transit bottlenecks, customs holds, and inventory shortfalls.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on supply chain anomalies and execute decisive mitigation strategies to preserve delivery continuity.
* Formalize escalation pathways and implement corrective measures to prevent recurring operational bottlenecks.

**Inventory Governance & Distribution Support**

* Maintain accurate inventory accountabilities across various distribution centers and regional storage facilities.
* Support periodic physical stock reconciliations, continuous cycle counts, and audit readiness initiatives.
* Monitor movement patterns between hubs to optimize regional stock positioning and mitigate shrinkage risks.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with Procurement, Logistics, IT Operations, Enterprise Architecture, and Warehouse teams to ensure cross-departmental alignment.
* Provide high-caliber customer service to internal business partners, managing expectations with clarity and professionalism.

**ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive experience in supply chain execution, operations delivery, or logistics coordination.
* Demonstrated capability to operate autonomously within a fast-paced environment and manage concurrent, competing priorities.
* Exceptional oral and written communication skills suitable for multi-tiered stakeholder reporting.

**DESIRABLE CRITERIA:**

* Prior technical exposure to enterprise technology infrastructure and hardware products (e.g., Dell, Cisco systems).
* Fundamental understanding of international trade compliance, customs regulations, and global import/export documentation.
* Practical exposure to supply planning principles, inventory auditing methodologies, or Lean Six Sigma process improvement frameworks.
