* Relevant experience in partner operations, sales operations, deal desk, order management, finance operations, or a similar revenue operations environment, including direct support for sales or partner sales teams, distributors, and partners, along with an interest in GitLab and open source software.
* Experience with enterprise quote-to-cash processes and configure, price, quote tools or other commercial systems in a channel or partner context.
* Experience with Salesforce and partner-management systems or portals.
* Strong analytical skills, including advanced spreadsheets, dashboard building in Salesforce or business intelligence tools such as Tableau, and turning data into clear recommendations.
* Hands-on experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to improve operational productivity, quality, or scale, including writing effective prompts, judging when outputs need human review, and sharing useful approaches with others.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize requests, investigate issues, identify exceptions, and escalate decisions to the appropriate owner, along with experience contributing to process improvement and automation.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining operational requirements to technical and non-technical audiences, documenting processes, creating enablement materials, and collaborating across Sales, Ecosystem, Programs, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Systems.

28d479aa364dc8d7d348.description:
Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/13/26.
  
Koniag Professional Services, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Web Content and Tier 2 Integration Specialist with a Secret security clearance to support KPS and our government customer. The position is remote.
  
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
This position combines hands-on web content management with application and integration support. The specialist will create, maintain, and publish content across public-facing and internal websites and applications while also providing Tier 2 troubleshooting for content management systems, website functionality, application integrations, user access, and related digital services.
  
  
The specialist will work closely with Operations Managers, content teams, technical teams, developers, and government stakeholders to investigate issues, coordinate resolutions, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure a consistent and reliable digital experience.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities:****The Web Content and Tier 2 Integration Specialist will:****Web Content Support:**  

* Use content management systems to create, update, maintain, and publish content for public-facing and internal websites and applications.
* Ensure web content is accurate, current, properly formatted, and consistent with established content and design standards.
* Coordinate website and application content updates through established review and government approval processes.
* Maintain a consistent look and feel across assigned websites and digital applications.
* Support Operations Managers and program stakeholders in implementing communications and content requirements.
* Manage standard operating procedures and administrative guides supporting website and application content management.
* Coordinate updates and changes across content, design, operations, and technical teams.
* Support the maintenance of online content inventories, schedules, and associated documentation.
* Review website content and functionality to identify broken links, outdated information, formatting issues, and other user-facing problems.
* Support web-based communications, events, webinars, and other digital activities as required.
* Maintain and update web content as operational requirements change.

**Tier 2 Application & Integration Support:**  

* Provide Tier 2 support for websites, content management systems, web applications, and associated integrations.
* Investigate incidents escalated from Tier 1 to determine the source and scope of website, application, content, configuration, access, or integration issues.
* Troubleshoot problems involving CMS functionality, authentication, permissions, web forms, links, content publishing, application behavior, and system interfaces.
* Replicate reported issues and document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolution activities.
* Determine whether incidents can be resolved through content, configuration, permissions, or documented administrative actions before escalation to development or Tier 3 support.
* Coordinate with developers and technical teams when issues require code changes, infrastructure support, application modifications, or deeper technical investigation.
* Validate fixes and application changes before incidents are closed or returned to users.
* Monitor and track recurring issues to identify potential problems requiring corrective action.
* Support troubleshooting associated with website and application integrations and the exchange of information between connected systems.
* Maintain technical and operational documentation, including knowledge base articles, troubleshooting procedures, known issues, and support guides.
* Provide clear and complete technical documentation when escalating issues to development, engineering, or Tier 3 support teams.
* Support testing and validation of website, CMS, application, and integration changes prior to production release.

**Project & Operations Support:**  

* Collect and analyze customer requests, project requirements, and technical issues to determine appropriate actions and support requirements.
* Coordinate schedules, requirements, dependencies, and activities across internal and external teams.
* Provide project support including documentation management, status tracking, task coordination, and follow-up.
* Work with Operations Managers and cross-functional teams to complete assigned activities and meet established milestones.
* Maintain project, content, application, and technical support documentation.
* Participate in meetings with government customers, Operations Managers, developers, designers, writers, and other supporting personnel.
* Communicate technical issues and solutions in clear language appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support development and maintenance of processes that improve website operations, content management, and Tier 2 support.

**Qualifications:****Clearance Requirement:**  

* Must hold an active Secret clearance supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

**Education:**  

* Bachelor's degree in communications, information technology, computer science, web development, digital media, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree when permitted by contract requirements.

Experience
  

* 3–5 years of experience supporting websites, web applications, content management systems, digital content, application support, or related technical operations.
* Experience using enterprise content management systems to create, maintain, and publish website content.
* Experience troubleshooting website or web application issues beyond basic Tier 1 support.
* Experience coordinating technical issues across content, operational, and development teams.
* Experience documenting technical issues, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and escalation information.
* Experience supporting federal government or DoD programs preferred.

**Technical Knowledge:****Required:**  

* Working knowledge of content management systems (CMS) and website publishing processes.
* Understanding of modern web technologies, including HTML and CSS, and the ability to troubleshoot basic presentation and content issues.
* Understanding of website architecture, navigation, links, forms, media, and common browser-related issues.
* Understanding of application troubleshooting, incident management, and Tier 2 escalation processes.
* Ability to investigate and document issues involving web applications and connected systems.
* Familiarity with user access, roles, permissions, and authentication concepts.
* Ability to use browser-based troubleshooting and diagnostic tools to investigate website and application issues.

**Preferred:**  

* Experience with WordPress or comparable enterprise content management platforms.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and web service integrations.
* Familiarity with application interfaces and integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with ITSM or service management platforms used to document and track incidents.
* Experience with source control, issue tracking, or development collaboration tools.
* Familiarity with testing activities performed as part of application updates and releases.
* Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility and accessible web content practices.
* Experience supporting websites or applications operating within secure federal or DoD environments.

**Skills:**  

* Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting ability.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate technical issues into understandable language for operational and program stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail when managing digital content and technical documentation.
* Ability to distinguish between content, configuration, integration, and application-development issues.
* Ability to manage multiple incidents, content requests, and project activities simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.
* Ability to work effectively across content, operations, development, infrastructure, and government stakeholder teams.
* Ability to follow established processes while identifying opportunities to improve troubleshooting and support procedures.
* Strong customer service orientation and ability to work effectively in an SLA-driven environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy
  
The company is an equal opportunity employer. The company shall not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, color, religion, creed, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity (except where gender is a bona fide occupational qualification), national origin or ancestry, age, disability, citizenship, military/veteran status, marital status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in all decisions related to employment, promotion, wages, benefits, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment.
  
  
The company is dedicated to seeking all qualified applicants. If you require an accommodation to navigate or apply for a position on our website, please get in touch with Heaven Wood via e-mail at accommodations@koniag-gs.com or by calling 703-488-9377 to request accommodations.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Koniag, we apply our proven commercial solutions to a deep knowledge of Defense and Civilian missions to provide forward leaning technical, professional, and operational solutions. 982e6071dc32b87810a4.title: Operations Assistant
982e6071dc32b87810a4.description:
**Employment Type:** Seasonal / Per Diem

**Pay Rate:** $20.00 per hour

**Expected Hours:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week

**Anticipated Start Date:** November 30, 2026

**Anticipated Hiring Decision:** November 13, 2026

**Work Location:** Remote / Work From Home

**Seasonal Employment Period:** December–March

This is a seasonal position, with employment expected to end at the conclusion of the winter season. JMC values its seasonal team members and looks forward to welcoming eligible employees back for future winter seasons based on operational needs and performance.

**About JMC Enterprises**

For over a decade, JMC has specialized in removing dangerous snow and ice from the tops of tractor-trailers across the Northeast before those trailers return to the road. Our mission is rooted in road safety, and our work depends on reliable communication, teamwork, and a strong commitment to supporting our field teams and customers.

**Position Description**

JMC Enterprises is seeking a dependable, organized Operations Assistant to support our winter snow and ice removal operations from home. In this role, you will help our operations team stay informed, organized, and responsive as weather conditions change. You will play a key role in supporting JMC's weather-dependent winter operations, with primary responsibilities including phone support, dispatch coordination, and professional communication with field technicians, customers, and their drivers. Additional responsibilities include weather monitoring, service-related outreach, recordkeeping, lodging arrangements, billing assistance, and reviewing and documenting technician dashcam footage.

This is a seasonal, per diem position with approximately 20–30 hours per week anticipated. Workload and scheduling may vary based on storm activity and operational needs. The ideal candidate is comfortable juggling priorities, working with digital systems, and communicating professionally in a fast-moving environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Operations Manager, Operations Coordinators and other assistants to plan, support and facilitate trailer-top now removal operations across 14 states.
* Provide professional and responsive phone support, communicating effectively with field technicians, customers, and their drivers regarding service requests, scheduling, and operational needs.
* Support storm planning and preparation through customer outreach, service coordination, and ongoing communication with the operations team.
* Monitor weather forecasts, track developing winter weather events, and accurately update and maintain JMC's weather forecasting tracker.
* Complete accurate and timely data entry while maintaining organized operational records.
* Coordinate and book lodging accommodations for field technicians as needed.
* Review, retrieve, and document technician dashcam footage using Verizon's Fleet Management System.
* Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as assigned, demonstrating flexibility, adaptability, and a willingness to support the team wherever needed.

  

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills, including phone etiquette.
* Comfort using computers, online platforms, and digital recordkeeping systems.
* Proficiency using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience using Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Outlook and One Drive.
* Ability to work independently from home while remaining responsive and collaborating with the operations team.
* Dependability, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information.
* Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and weather-driven operational demands, including changing or rotating shift days and times. Flexibility to work weekends as needed.
* A reliable internet connection and a suitable, distraction-limited remote work environment.
* Experience in dispatch, logistics, scheduling, administrative support, or fleet systems is a plus.

**Workplace Culture & Professional Expectations**

At JMC, our culture is built on safety, communication, collaboration, trust, integrity, and a positive, team-first attitude. Our Core Values guide how we work, how we treat one another, and how we support our customers and field technicians.

We expect every team member to communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally; demonstrate accountability and follow through on commitments; maintain confidentiality; embrace feedback; and approach challenges with a positive, solution-focused mindset. Team members must be dependable, adaptable, and willing to step in wherever needed to support the team, especially during fast-paced winter weather operations.

**Ready to Support a Safer Winter?**

We look forward to hearing from dependable candidates who want to make a difference behind the scenes of our winter operations.

JMC participates in E-Verify and uses Form I-9 information to confirm employment authorization in the United States.

f74b47ea360099c74cea.title: CCA Practice Operations Manager
f74b47ea360099c74cea.description:
**About Us:**  
Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.
  
Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.
  
The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.
  
Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.
  
More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.
  
Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.
  
  
**Short Description:**  
The CCA Practice Ops Manager will serve as a key resource for CCA operations for the practice. This position must have working knowledge of Ambulatory Administrative and Clinical Operations. Supervise and manage staff, including hiring, training, scheduling, and performance evaluation. Oversee daily operations of the practice, including managing patient flow, scheduling appointments, and managing inventory. Develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure efficient and effective practice operations. Collaborate with the CCA Practice Medical Director to ensure quality metrics and goals are successfully met. Minimum 3+ years of management experience with a strong and extensive background in building strong relationships and managing teams with staff at multiple levels. Proven success in managing programs, fiscal, and employee HR matters, statement of operations, budgets to ensure the success of operations. Working knowledge of regulatory compliances in an ambulatory setting with a strong understanding of HIPAA and business practices. Must display excellent written, organizational, and verbal communication skills. This individual will have direct responsibility for the facility/practice and work closely with the Director of Clinical Practice and Regulatory Compliance along with the Asst Director of Quality & Safety for Cooper Care Alliance. Responsible for overseeing all administrative and business operation aspects of a private medical or wellness practice. Their duties include hiring employees, ensuring compliance with regulations, and managing the budget of the practice. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills. Computer literacy and knowledge of relevant health care and administrative software. Good leadership, motivation, training, and goal-setting skills with an understanding of P&L’s and operation statements. In-depth knowledge of health care finances, best practices and standards. Great organization and time management skills with the understanding of health and safety standards in the medical industry. Must have the ability to establish and implement effective workplace procedures and ensure policies are followed. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Must be detailed oriented and able to perform in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with proficiency in strong computer (EHR) and IT system capabilities i.e. Microsoft Office, Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  
  
Set strategic goals with sound analysis and projections for business success
  
Review and renew, or establish standard operating procedures for organizational operations, including legal and regulatory compliance.
  
Establish and implement effective workplace procedures
  
Ensure policies and best practices are up to industry standards and government regulations
  
Oversee and provide direct oversight of PSRs, MAs and clinical operations
  
  
Hire, train and monitor administrative operations
  
Monitor the inventory for medications and medical equipment and organize for resupply.
  
Interact with patients and address their complaints
  
Coordinate regular staff meetings and performance reviews
  
Collaborate with physicians to develop business strategies and patient services
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  
Understanding of health and safety standards in the medical industry
  
Good understanding of regulatory, human relations and HIPAA
  
Must have knowledge and the ability to complete Kronos payroll, PTO, staffing schedules and evaluations
  
Must have knowledge of P&L’s, budgets and business operations
  
Perform data reporting for CCA and ensure all departmental goals are met.
  
Collaborate with CCA Practice Medical Director to ensure quality, patient access metrics and administrative stats are met.
  
All other duties as assigned
  
  
**Experience Required:**  
3 Years plus experience
  
  
**Education Requirements:**  
Bachelor's degree Preferred

0daeda5c05e7b81baebf.title: IT Operations & Case Management Specialist
0daeda5c05e7b81baebf.description:
**About Blueprint**

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

**In This Role**
----------------

You will support infrastructure capacity operations by managing incoming requests through a case tracking system, ensuring each request is complete, accurate, and routed to the appropriate owner. This role focuses on escalation triage, data validation, queue management, and operational reporting in a high-volume environment. You will resolve routine cases by following established procedures, track outstanding actions, maintain accurate records and budget trackers, and prepare weekly metrics on request volumes, backlogs, and escalations. You will also identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements. All capacity allocation decisions, exception approvals, and policy determinations remain with authorized internal personnel.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Review, triage, prioritize, and route incoming infrastructure capacity requests through a case management system.
* Validate request details, including identifiers, product SKUs, regions, core counts, and other required information.
* Follow up with requestors to obtain missing or incorrect information and ensure cases meet established requirements.
* Resolve routine cases in accordance with documented procedures and service guidelines.

**Title**  
POS Help Desk, Specialist I
  
Helpdesk & Technical Support - POS

**Reports To**  
POS Manager, Help Desk

**About Payroc**  
Payroc is a global payments technology company helping businesses get paid, grow faster, and operate smarter. From powerful POS systems to seamless online and mobile payment solutions, we equip merchants with the tools they need to succeed in today's fast-moving commerce landscape.

At Payroc, our culture is built around people who lead with grit, take ownership, and are not afraid to be a boss when it comes to driving results. We believe the best solutions start when we listen first to our customers, our partners, and each other so we can deliver payment experiences that truly make a difference for the businesses we serve.

We are a team that moves quickly, thinks entrepreneurially, and celebrates big wins together. If you are energized by building relationships, solving real business problems, and creating opportunities for yourself and your clients, Payroc is the kind of place where you can make an impact and grow your career.

**Position Overview**

The POS Help Desk Specialist I provides first-line technical support to merchants, helping resolve issues with point-of-sale hardware, software, and payment processing. This role combines troubleshooting with customer service to keep merchants’ daily operations running smoothly.

As an initial point of contact, this individual guides merchants through common technical issues, system configurations, and basic usage questions while documenting support interactions and following through on resolution. The specialist also partners with advanced support teams to escalate complex issues and contributes to support resources that improve the merchant experience.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide Tier 1 support via phone, email, or ticketing system to merchants experiencing issues with POS hardware, software, or payment processing
* Accurately log and track all support interactions in the help desk system, ensuring proper documentation and case resolution
* Troubleshoot common issues including device connectivity, transaction errors, printer/PIN pad malfunctions, and user interface problems
* Assist merchants with system configurations, password resets, basic training, and usage guidance
* Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to Tier 2 support or technical engineering teams as appropriate
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supported hardware, POS platforms, and payment software
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of knowledge base articles and support documentation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ year of experience in a technical support, help desk, or customer service role
* Basic understanding of POS systems, networking, or payment terminal equipment
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users
* Ability to manage multiple support tickets and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with Windows, iOS, or Android operating systems and remote support tools
* Detail-oriented with a commitment to accurate documentation and follow-up

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting POS systems (e.g., Clover, Toast, Revel, Aloha, Lightspeed, Square)
* Familiarity with payment processing systems, EMV, PCI compliance, or merchant services
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud
* Exposure to ticketing platforms such as Jira, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or ServiceNow
* Bilingual capabilities are a plus

**Travel Component**

* NA

**Working Conditions**

* Working hours are approximately 2:00 - 11:00PM (PST). Weekend availability required.
* Extensive desk-based work involving prolonged periods using a computer and sitting for extended periods

**Job Classification**

* Non-Exempt

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individuals' qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, national social or ethnic origin, sex, age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, sexual orientation or any other status protected by the laws regulation in the location we operate. Payroc does not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

Payroc is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact Human Resources Department at HR@payroc.com

All internal applicants will need to apply with our Internal Application Form and review the Internal Application Policy. Please reach out to HR@payroc.com to discuss.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. Actual compensation may vary based on a number of factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Depending on the position offered, additional forms of compensation – such as bonuses, incentives, or equity – may also be included as part of the total compensation package. **Syms Strategic Group (SSG)** is seeking a talented **Edifecs Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Analyst Transaction Specialist**  
**Location:** Remote  
**Department:** Veterans Affairs (VA)  
**Type:** Full Time  
**Min. Experience:** Experienced

***If you have previously applied to Syms Strategic Group (SSG), there is no need to reapply. Applications are still under review.***  
  
**Military Veterans are highly encouraged to apply!**  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

* Own functional EDI workflows, partner requirements, and data validation rules
* Ensure accurate transaction processing and support business operations
* Interpret and troubleshoot transaction sets: 270/271, 276/277, 278, 820, 834, 835, 837, 999/277CA
* Analyze Strategic National Implementation Process (SNIP) compliance, companion guides, and partner-specific validation rules
* Document mapping/logical requirements for new partners and integration changes
* Partner with business stakeholders for issue resolution and operational impact assessments
* Support audit/compliance reviews and maintain data quality guardrails
* Collaborate with EDI Analysts, DevSecOps Engineers, Cloud teams, and business teams
* Work with integration specialists on Applicability Statement 2 (AS2), Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), and Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) flows
* Validate data sent to/received from non-X.12 partners
* Identify issues introduced by middleware layers or APIs
* Query Structured Query Language (SQL) for transaction details
* Validate payloads, timestamps, statuses, and error flags
* Reconcile mismatches between raw EDI and stored data

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* A strong understanding of payer/provider workflows
* An ability to interpret loops/segmets/element-level errors
* Familiarity with Edifecs Transaction Management or equivalent tools
* Strong experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* A strong understanding of EDI X.12 Loop/segment/element interpretation, SNIP validations (Levels 1-7), companion guide interpretation, and error analysis at segment or element level
* Experience with interpreting Edifecs XEngine validation results and understanding processing rules and transaction profiles
* Experience working with SpecBuilder maps and implementation guides
* An ability to identify issues sourced from Edifecs routes, profiles, or rulesets
* An ability to interpret Edifecs logs and error codes (functional layer, not platform admin level)
* Proficiency with identifying root causes of transaction errors, resolving mapping mismatches, troubleshooting rejections from payers or state systems, and reviewing parsed EDI structures stored in SQL databases
* An ability to understand inbound/outbound workflow architecture
* A strong ability to communicate technical architecture decisions and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience gathering and translating business reporting requirements into technical data models
* Comfort driving ambiguous architecture decisions to resolution with limited direction
* Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban) and JIRA
* Strong documentation habits with creating transaction flow documentation, error trend reports, escalations, and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and partner reference guides

  

**Professional Certifications**

EDIFECS certification

  

**Years of Professional Experience**

8+ years of experience of Edifecs product experience in EDI, healthcare, or enterprise application operations  
8+ years of EDI/Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)

  

**Desired experience**

Deep hands-on EDIFECS experience in Electronic Data Interchange X.12 (EDI) Transactions Standards involving key X12 workflows involving the following transactions:

* X.12 medical claims (837, 834, 835, 276/277, etc)
* 270/271 and 278 transactions
* 820 transactions
* 999/277CA transactions

Knowledge of HIPAA compliance requirements in cloud data architecture  
Experience with healthcare payer/PBM systems, clearinghouses, or pharmacy operations  
AWS certification in a bonus

  

**Formal Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience considered

  

**Citizenship Requirement**

**U.S. Citizenship required for this specific opportunity**

  

**Security Clearance Requirements**

Must possess or qualify for a Public Trust (MBI)

  

**CRITICAL NOTES:**

* SSG will not make assumptions regarding your qualifications. Your answers to the mandatory screening questions must be supported by the information on your resume. Applications with inconsistencies will not be considered.
* Recruiters or Third parties will not be considered.
* This is a 100% U.S. based remote position. However, candidates from CA, CO, IL, MN, NJ, NY, OR, or WA will not be considered.
* This is a W-2 position
* All interviews will be conducted on Microsoft Teams with your camera on; there will be no exceptions
* As part of our screening process, you will be requested to provide a link to your LinkedIn profile

  
***U.S Citizenship is required for this specific opportunity***. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information and be able to obtain a government-granted security clearance. Individuals may also be subject to a background investigation including, but not limited to criminal history, employment and education verification, drug testing, and creditworthiness.  
  
Syms Strategic Group, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or genetic information.

**We’re delighted you’re considering joining us!**

At Hill Physicians Medical Group, we’re shaping the healthcare of the future: actively managed care that prevents disease, supports those with chronic conditions and anticipates the needs of our members.

**Join Our Team!**

Hill Physicians has much to offer prospective employees. We’re regularly recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work in the Bay Area” and have been recognized as one of the “Healthiest Places to Work in the Bay Area.” When you join our team, you’re making a great choice for your professional career and your personal satisfaction.

**DE&I Statement:**

At PriMed, your uniqueness is valued, celebrated, encouraged, supported, and embraced. Whatever your relationship with Hill Physicians, we welcome ALL that you are.

We value and respect your race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, disabilities, experiences, perspectives, and other attributes. Our celebration of diversity and foundation of inclusion allows us to leverage our differences and capitalize on our similarities to better serve our communities. We do it because it's right!

**Job Description:**

Under the leadership of the Applications Manager, the Application Analysts primary role is to have a complete working knowledge of assigned application, to include an understanding of the assigned department workflows for the associated system build/configure, upgrade and release process. The Application Analyst will act as the primary support contact for the application and coordinate issues that arise in their area of responsibility and must be very knowledgeable about the organization's policies, procedures, and business operations. They will perform workflow analysis, data collection and report issues associated with the software. The Application Analyst will serve as a liaison between team, end users, third parties and technical staff. They will work with end users by participating in training and troubleshooting issues and questions. Senior level technical professional. Completes complex work within a discipline or specialty area. Helps others understand the why and articulates the importance to others they work with. Owns processes and continually incorporates feedback to improve them. Proactively audits process to improve before an issue occurs. Caters to individual styles and abilities. Teaches new skills. Helps talk through situations with operational stakeholders. Makes recommendations for new functionality for issue avoidance or operation improvement. Pushes back when operations or IT is steering down the wrong path.

**Specialization**

The Epic Revenue Cycle (Professional Billing) Application Analyst serves as the primary application specialist responsible for the design, configuration, support, optimization, and ongoing maintenance of Epic Resolute Professional Billing applications and workflows. This role provides technical expertise in professional billing, claims management, reimbursement, charge processing, and revenue cycle operations to support accurate billing, efficient claims processing, regulatory compliance, and organizational financial objectives.

The analyst configures and supports Epic Professional Billing functionality, including claims processing, electronic claims submission, electronic remittance advice (ERA), charge review, payer configuration, benefits integration, billing work queues, reimbursement workflows, and revenue cycle automation. The role ensures applications are designed and maintained in accordance with Epic best practices while supporting revenue integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance requirements.

Working closely with Revenue Cycle Operations, Patient Financial Services, Clinical Operations, Information Services, and operational leadership, the analyst gathers business requirements, translates operational needs into technical solutions, and implements workflow enhancements that improve billing accuracy, reimbursement performance, and overall revenue cycle effectiveness. The analyst also serves as a subject matter expert, providing technical consultation, production support, workflow optimization, integrated testing, system documentation, and end-user guidance.

The position is responsible for troubleshooting and resolving complex billing and claims issues by analyzing workflows, application configuration, interfaces, and downstream financial systems. The analyst supports system upgrades, new functionality implementations, testing activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance automation, reduce claim denials, improve reimbursement outcomes, and strengthen overall system performance.

All work is performed in accordance with organizational policies, payer requirements, HIPAA regulations, information security standards, and applicable regulatory guidelines.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Performs work that is complex and varied in nature
* Solves complex problems by defining and discerning key aspects of the problem
* Takes a new perspective on existing solutions. Recommends new procedures and processes to achieve results.
* Understands the why behind the question.
* Communicates build/configure, or workflow improvements that solves the broader need.
* Acting as the primary support contact for the application's end‐users
* Provide software product function, design, and build/configure expertise needed for successful product implementation.
* Identifying issues that arise in their application area as well as issues that affect other application teams, and working to resolve them
* Guiding workflow design, build/configuring and testing the system, and analyzing other technical issues associated with software ensuring design and configuration meets patient care and business needs
* Works with the IS. Team members, vendors and customers to ensure that the application systems are properly maintained and necessary changes are reliably tested, implemented, and documentation is current. Serving as a liaison between end users' workflow needs and implementation staff
* Maintaining regular communication with software representatives, business community, and end users to ensure the system meets the organization's business needs in regards to the project deliverables and timeline
* Developing an understanding of operational needs to set the direction for the organization's workflows by attending site visits and other integrated sessions
* Expert in workflows identifies areas for system optimization and process improvement. Develops solutions and collaborates with the team and management to implement these solutions.
* Works to ensure that user problems and configuration requests are appropriately addressed, and system upgrades are successfully executed with minimal disruption to operations
* Develops and manages effective customer relationships with end-users and other team members to enhance the timeliness and effectiveness of technology solutions.
* Responds promptly to the needs of end-users, and meets Service Level Agreements as defined in conjunction with our customers following issues through to closure.
* Participates in team and leadership meetings to discuss team and ongoing project related activities, issues, change, communications, and updates.
* Typically provides training and guidance to colleagues with less experience, but no formal supervisory responsibility
* May be accountable for leading small projects with moderate risk
* Recognizes when the team needs to be given direction. Proactively looks for feedback to share in their peers work and solicits feedback in return.
* Proactively teaches others on the team. Seeks out areas or issues to lead.
* Digs deeper to root out potential issues or opportunities.

**Required Experience and Professional Skills**

**Experience**

* 5-7 years of experience in Healthcare industry and previous experience in required application discipline
* Current Epic certification in Resolute Professional Billing Administration and Claims and Remittance Administration required
* Additional Epic certifications in Professional Billing Expected Reimbursement Contracts •Administration, other Revenue Cycle applications, various cross application like Hello World, Mychart, Cadence, and Prelude desirable

**Professional Skills**

* Complete application system knowledge
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Requires in-depth knowledge and experience. Has developed deep conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines
* Understands workflows, and makes thoughtful recommendations on the fly. Creates unique solutions based on experiences and knowledge of other's build/configure and workflows. Incorporates future software direction into recommendations. Expert in a given area.
* Solves basic issues for integrated areas independently. Validates recommendations with other teams.
* Brings perspective from other organizations and tailors message based on operational needs.
* Ability to tailor communication to the audience. Communicates priority and urgency directly.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with others, gain trust and build/configure strong relationships
* Ability to work independently and function as an integral part of the team
* Flexibility and adaptability with respect to changing end‐user business needs
* The ability and willingness to see things in an open‐minded way and examine an idea or concept from as many angles as possible
* The ability and willingness to take ownership of work activities and ensure that they are completed in an accurate, efficient, and timely manner
* The ability and willingness to recognize assignments or tasks that need to be completed, to seek out additional assignments or tasks, and to help others

* The ability to persevere in difficult situations, overcome obstacles, and reach high levels of performance when faced with stressful work situations and time pressures
* The willingness to put forth extra effort when required, including demonstrating persistence in the face of obstacles and adversity

The Associate Luxury Resale Advisor (ALRA) is a key sales position at The RealReal focused on driving new business growth and reactivating lapsed consignor relationships. As an ALRA, you will grow your consignor base by acquiring luxury goods from new clients and reconnecting with past consignors who have not recently consigned. You have an entrepreneurial spirit, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are energized by building relationships from the ground up. At TRR, you are more than just points of contact; you are essential partners to our consignors. By cultivating deep relationships and understanding each consignor’s closet, you will provide strategic guidance on what and when to consign to maximize their return. You are customer-obsessed, adaptable, and passionate about luxury brands, fashion, and sustainability. Above all, you embody the TRR culture through collaboration, driving results, and building for the future.

**What You Get To Do Every Day**
================================

* Client Outreach: Engage new, inactive, and prospective clients through daily outreach and in-home appointments to drive consignment activity. Develop and execute creative networking and outreach strategies to attract new consignors, reactivate lapsed consignor relationships, and generate repeat business.
* Lead Generation & Conversion: Proactively build pipeline by sourcing new leads, reactivating lapsed consignors, and converting marketing-qualified leads into active consignors. Leverage tools, such as Salesforce, to effectively manage pipeline activity and opportunities.
* Sales Performance: Consistently meet or exceed monthly quotas by driving new business growth, reactivation results, and key performance metrics that contribute to overall revenue growth.
* Client Experience: Deliver a high-touch, white-glove experience throughout the consignment process to ensure client satisfaction, trust, and long-term engagement, while building meaningful client relationships that extend beyond convenience and transactional service.
* Contract Management & Client Consultations: Clearly present and review consignment contracts, establish pricing expectations using internal tools and luxury market expertise, and guide clients through each step of the process.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Retail teams to support sales growth and collaborate closely with the Consignor Relations team to proactively address and resolve client concerns.
* Consignment Procurement & Logistics: Acquire luxury consignment items from clients and oversee the end-to-end coordination of item pickup and shipment to The RealReal’s e-commerce centers.
* Field Work: Spend the majority of time, over 70%, in the field, cultivating client relationships and securing consigned items through personalized, in-home appointments.

**What Great Looks Like (Performance)**

* Executes with strong pipeline discipline across new business, reactivation, and follow-up activity.
* Maintains consistent outreach volume and demonstrates improving lead-to-consignment conversion effectiveness.
* Builds early momentum in new consignor acquisition, reactivated accounts, and overall consignment value contribution.
* Demonstrates resilience by staying motivated through rejection, overcoming objections, and consistently turning “no” into future opportunities.
* Creates opportunities through prospecting, networking, and effective use of inbound leads.
* Demonstrates ownership, coachability, disciplined execution, and trust-based client relationships.
* Balances speed and quality by moving opportunities efficiently while delivering a high-touch client experience.
* Shows strong follow-through, dependable communication, and accountability to commitments.

**Core Competencies (Baseline)**

* Entrepreneurial drive and ownership mindset
* Coachability and learning agility
* Results orientation and competitive drive
* Relationship building and client trust
* Prospecting and business development acumen
* Operational discipline & follow-through
* Self-management and resilience
* Adaptability in a fast-paced, field-based environment

**What You Bring To The Role**
==============================

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Technologically proficient; comfortable leveraging CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), digital tools to manage pipeline and drive performance.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset who adapts quickly to shifting priorities.
* Highly motivated by ownership, growth, and impact, with the drive to build a book of business and continuously improve performance.
* Results-oriented, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, field-based environment.
* Exceptional ability to build rapport, earn trust, and communicate effectively regarding high-value goods / services with discerning clientele.
* Strong relationship-building, organizational, and problem-solving skills; excellent verbal and written communication.
* Customer-obsessed with a passion for luxury, fashion, and sustainability.
* Willing and able to travel more than 70% within the designated market.

Able to commit to a 40-hour workweek with occasional off-hours; must reside in the assigned territory, possess a valid driver’s license (except in Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Chicago markets), maintain compliant insurance and driving record, and lift up to 25 lbs as needed.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Tech proficiency in Salesforce (or similar CRM).
* Prior experience in selling luxury goods and/or high-end services.
* Strong understanding of fashion trends and the luxury market.

**Compensation, Benefits, + Perks**
===================================

* Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Annual Elite Club Trip for top performers
* Monthly sales competitions (i.e. cash | prizes | site credit)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* 401K with Company Match
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Paid Parental Leave
* 9 Paid Company Holidays
* Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)
* Find out more about our Benefits here.

The expected salary range for this role is $60,000-$70,000. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.The expected On-Target Earnings range for this role is $75,000-$87,500. To determine on-target earnings, the range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets.

The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.

The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.

The Service Desk Lead manages Triumph's Tier 2 service desk and release support team for a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) claims-processing product line. You own delivery to the service-level agreements, lead a remote team of analysts across extended hours, and are the contractor's primary point of contact with the VA program office.

* Lead the 60-day transition-in: knowledge transfer, staff onboarding, background investigation tracking and Government-furnished equipment (GFE)
* Run the Tier 2 service desk: staffing schedules across 102 coverage hours a week, 24/7 on-call rotation, two-senior-analyst review before escalation
* Notify the VA C&P Service Desk Manager and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) of high/critical priority incidents within 30 minutes and provide hourly updates

* Able to read, write, speak and understand English
* Able to obtain and keep a VA Tier 2 / Moderate Risk background investigation; complete VA privacy and security training and sign the Contractor Rules of Behavior before system access
* 7+ years in IT service desk or application support, including 3+ years leading Tier 2 teams of 10 or more
* Experience managing to service-level agreements in ServiceNow
* Bachelor's degree, or 4 additional years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Able to travel about once a year (2 days; Charleston, SC or Washington, DC)

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
* ITIL 4 Foundation
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (Triumph will sponsor the exam for the selected candidate)

**OTHER PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Current VA or other federal Public Trust / Moderate Risk investigation (reciprocity to be confirmed)
* Experience with VA Veterans Benefits Management System (VBMS) or Veterans Benefits Administration (VBA) claims applications
* Federal contract transition experience

**SCHEDULE AND LOCATION**

Remote within the United States; core hours Eastern; escalation point for 24/7 on-call; 1 trip a year.

**WHY TRIUMPH**

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, operating under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. We price our work based on local market wages, ensuring we fairly compensate our team rather than paying the bare minimum.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire strictly on the basis of qualifications and merit, providing equal consideration to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

22e73e0a28fca0d28642.description:
**About Us:**  
Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Norcross Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.
  
Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.
  
The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.
  
Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.
  
More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.
  
Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org to learn more.
  
  
**Short Description:**  
The CCA Practice Ops Manager will serve as a key resource for CCA operations for the practice. This position must have working knowledge of Ambulatory Administrative and Clinical Operations. Supervise and manage staff, including hiring, training, scheduling, and performance evaluation. Oversee daily operations of the practice, including managing patient flow, scheduling appointments, and managing inventory. Develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure efficient and effective practice operations. Collaborate with the CCA Practice Medical Director to ensure quality metrics and goals are successfully met. Minimum 3+ years of management experience with a strong and extensive background in building strong relationships and managing teams with staff at multiple levels. Proven success in managing programs, fiscal, and employee HR matters, statement of operations, budgets to ensure the success of operations. Working knowledge of regulatory compliances in an ambulatory setting with a strong understanding of HIPAA and business practices. Must display excellent written, organizational, and verbal communication skills. This individual will have direct responsibility for the facility/practice and work closely with the Director of Clinical Practice and Regulatory Compliance along with the Asst Director of Quality & Safety for Cooper Care Alliance. Responsible for overseeing all administrative and business operation aspects of a private medical or wellness practice. Their duties include hiring employees, ensuring compliance with regulations, and managing the budget of the practice. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills. Computer literacy and knowledge of relevant health care and administrative software. Good leadership, motivation, training, and goal-setting skills with an understanding of P&L’s and operation statements. In-depth knowledge of health care finances, best practices and standards. Great organization and time management skills with the understanding of health and safety standards in the medical industry. Must have the ability to establish and implement effective workplace procedures and ensure policies are followed. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Must be detailed oriented and able to perform in a fast-paced environment. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with proficiency in strong computer (EHR) and IT system capabilities i.e. Microsoft Office, Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  
  
Set strategic goals with sound analysis and projections for business success
  
Review and renew, or establish standard operating procedures for organizational operations, including legal and regulatory compliance.
  
Establish and implement effective workplace procedures
  
Ensure policies and best practices are up to industry standards and government regulations
  
Oversee and provide direct oversight of PSRs, MAs and clinical operations
  
  
Hire, train and monitor administrative operations
  
Monitor the inventory for medications and medical equipment and organize for resupply.
  
Interact with patients and address their complaints
  
Coordinate regular staff meetings and performance reviews
  
Collaborate with physicians to develop business strategies and patient services
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  
Understanding of health and safety standards in the medical industry
  
Good understanding of regulatory, human relations and HIPAA
  
Must have knowledge and the ability to complete Kronos payroll, PTO, staffing schedules and evaluations
  
Must have knowledge of P&L’s, budgets and business operations
  
Perform data reporting for CCA and ensure all departmental goals are met.
  
Collaborate with CCA Practice Medical Director to ensure quality, patient access metrics and administrative stats are met.
  
All other duties as assigned
  
  
**Experience Required:**  
3+ years’ experience in management and operations in Ambulatory Care setting
  
Prior leadership experience a must
  
  
**Education Requirements:**  
Bachelor Degree Preferred

c83e72de511045032225.description:
**Location**
------------

USA - Remote

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**

Marketing

**Compensation**
----------------

There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.
  
  
Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits.

  

**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**Team Overview**
-----------------

Events and field marketing are Deepgram's largest demand generation investment, and this role owns North America. Reporting to the Director of Demand Gen, you'll run 20+ trade shows and conferences each year, partner co-hosted programs, and field programs with Sales, splitting your time between flagship brand moments and programs that move target accounts. You'll help set event strategy with marketing leadership and work closely with regional sales leaders, Product Marketing, alliances, Demand Generation, SDRs, and Marketing Operations. The role starts as a senior individual contributor, with room to grow a team.

**Key Goals**
-------------

* Run the North America trade show and sponsorship portfolio end to end, from turnkey kiosks to flagship presences at AWS re:Invent and Dreamforce, including budget, MDF and partner co-op funding, contracts, and vendors.
* Help set event strategy, the annual plan, and the calendar for third-party and hosted events with marketing leadership, backed by data on budget, investment tiering, and portfolio mix.
* Equip Sales, alliances, and Demand Generation before and after marquee events so they invite the right accounts and turn attendance into pipeline, expansion, and retention.
* Keep every event on product messaging and the voice of the customer, timed to product launches and sales priorities.
* Design and run field programs with regional sales leaders, such as executive dinners, roadshows, customer events, and account-based plays against named target accounts.
* Co-host events with hyperscaler, CCaaS, and voice AI partners like AWS, Twilio, Five9, and NVIDIA, so Deepgram shows up where their customers already are.
* Concept and deliver brand activations at competitor-heavy shows, from stadium takeovers to interactive demos and hosted moments.
* Close the loop on every program with same-day lead logging, a fast-follow SLA with Sales, clean SDR routing, and a standard post-event scorecard tied to pipeline and cost per opportunity.
* Grow Deepgram Speak as a first-party event series and support community programming in our SF and NYC offices.

**Minimum Skills, Knowledge & Capabilities**
--------------------------------------------

* Has run flagship presences at large-scale shows (re:Invent, Dreamforce, or similar) end to end: contracting, booth, logistics, staffing, speakers, and lead capture.
* Owns both trade shows and field programs hands-on, and treats regional sales leaders as core partners.
* Shapes an annual event plan, not only executes one: makes tiering and portfolio calls with data and can explain what to cut and why.
* Ties event and field activity to sourced and influenced pipeline in Salesforce, working with Marketing Ops on campaign setup, attribution, and lead routing.
* Analyzes funnel metrics and event ROI, and presents clear recommendations to executive and sales leadership.
* Manages program budgets, negotiates vendor contracts, and holds agencies to quality and timelines.
* Takes an original creative concept from sketch to a fully produced experience.
* Operates AI-native: builds AI and automation workflows that cut manual work in planning, logistics, comms, and reporting, and turns them into playbooks others adopt.
* Flags risks and opportunities early and keeps many stakeholders aligned through clear communication.

**Preferred Qualifications** ***(nice-to-have, not required)***
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Typically ~7–10 years in B2B events and/or field marketing, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Managed a 7-figure annual program budget.
* Co-marketed events with hyperscalers (AWS especially) or channel partners, including MDF management.
* Hands-on with modern event tech: registration platforms, lead retrieval, meeting booking tools, mobile event apps, and CRM/MAP integrations.
* Background at AI, developer tools, API, or infrastructure companies, or familiarity with CX/contact center, healthcare, or fintech buyer communities.

**Our Values**
--------------

* Be You — bring your whole self and a different perspective; diverse viewpoints make our products better.
* Be Curious — challenge the status quo, keep learning, and ask 'how might we?' instead of accepting limits.
* Grow Together — push each other to do great work, treat feedback as a gift, and leave the drama out.
* Do the Right Thing — act with integrity and candor, assume best intent, choose ethics over expediency.
* Think Smart. Act Fast. — weigh the high-leverage options, decide, and move; no analysis paralysis.
* Put the Customer First — listen with empathy, understand their goals, and let their success drive ours.

*We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting great candidates — so please don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you.*

***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

Compensation Range: $160K - $210K

e13ba954fc1ec82f8d20.description:
**Director of Customer Service Operations**
===========================================

**Location:** Remote (United States)

**Compensation:** $150,000 - $175,000 base, OTE $175,000 - $225,000 + Equity

**Reports to:** Vice President, Customer Experience

**About Clever**
----------------

Clever Real Estate is a venture-backed proptech company on a mission to change how people buy, sell, and manage real estate. Since 2017, we've helped more than 200,000 homeowners sell their homes while saving thousands in fees, and we're just getting started. With a strong foundation in real estate, we're aggressively expanding through vertical integration, building a suite of adjacent businesses that serve customers at every step of the home transaction journey.

We've built a leading real estate platform and earned a 4.9 TrustPilot rating with over 4,000 reviews, helping consumers save over $220 million in real estate fees.

As a team, we FORGE leaders. We move with Frequency and urgency, take Ownership of outcomes, build genuine Relationships, commit to Growth every day, and hold ourselves to a standard of Excellence we're always raising. If you're excited to play a key role at a company that transforms how people navigate their real estate journey, we'd love to hear from you!

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on customer service and operations leader for Customer Success and Matching. Customer Success supports customers across phone, email, SMS, escalations, issue resolution, customer feedback, and cross-team handoffs. Matching connects customers with partner agents across multiple stages and channels.

The Director will lead managers and individual contributors, set priorities, stabilize the frontline team, and improve service, reporting, documentation, routing, onboarding, and ownership. They will stay close to the work, use customer, team, and performance data to form an independent view, and step into frontline work when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Operational Strategy and Performance**

* Own service quality, capacity, and performance across Customer Success and Matching. Establish clear measures and turn customer and performance insights into priorities and action.
* Build and manage a focused improvement roadmap that balances process, technology, automation, and staffing. Partner across Product, Data, and Operations to test changes, measure results, and scale, adjust, or stop them based on what works.

**Customer Service and Matching Operations**

* ### **Own and improve the end-to-end customer matching operation, with clear standards, ownership, and measures for speed, completion, and quality.**
* ### **Identify and implement process and technology improvements, partnering with Product when needed, to improve match quality, increase capacity, and reduce manual work.**
* ### **Own Customer Success operations across phone, email, SMS, and other channels. Set clear standards for service, quality, coverage, and capacity.**
* Improve routing, handoffs, escalations, and documentation so work reaches the right owner and customers receive timely support.
* Use customer feedback and demand trends to guide process, technology, automation, and staffing decisions that improve quality and increase capacity.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop team leads and individual contributors. Set clear expectations, establish ownership and accountability, and address performance issues directly.
* Strengthen hiring and onboarding, and build team routines, documentation, and backup coverage that distribute ownership and keep work moving.
* Be willing to personally handle customer contacts and complete matching work during staffing gaps, urgent issues, or key learning periods. Use that firsthand experience to improve the operation, then return ownership to the team.

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

You are a hands-on customer service and operations builder who can quickly understand a complex, evolving environment and turn the highest-impact opportunities into a focused roadmap. You combine sound judgment, customer insight, and data to improve service and capacity while building a team that can operate without depending on you.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 10+ years in customer-facing operations with direct responsibility for service, quality, capacity, and performance.
* 3+ years in a people leadership role, with direct experience managing frontline individual contributors and managers, developing leaders, handling performance problems, and stepping into frontline work.
* Experience building or improving service operations, including workflows, ticketing, routing, escalations, documentation, onboarding, and reporting.
* ### **Strong business judgment and the ability to make sound decisions using customer insights and imperfect data.**
* ### **A track record of using process improvements, technology, and automation to produce measurable gains in service quality or capacity.**
* ### **Experience leading teams through high volume and changing priorities while influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners.**

**Helpful Experience**
----------------------

* Experience in real estate, proptech, or another technology-enabled service business is helpful. Familiarity with HubSpot, Front, or Five9 is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**In 90 days…**You have developed a clear understanding of our customers, team, operations, systems, and performance across Customer Success and Matching. You have established initial performance baselines and clarified near-term priorities, ownership, coverage, and escalation paths. You have aligned leaders on a focused improvement roadmap, identified staffing and onboarding needs, and launched at least one targeted improvement with an agreed measure of success and early results.

**In 6 months…**The highest-priority workflows and service standards are clear and consistently followed across Customer Success and Matching Team members have clear ownership and accountability, with the coaching and support needed to grow in their roles. Onboarding follows a consistent process, and critical work has documented backup coverage. Leaders use trustworthy reporting to guide decisions, and process and technology improvements have produced measurable gains while balancing customer experience, service quality, speed, cost, capacity, and business outcomes.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

**Salary**: $150,000 - $175,000 base, OTE $175,000 - $225,000 + Equity

**Paid Time Off:** 18 days of PTO (increases with tenure) plus 10 paid holidays
