6dc11e9a648ba6a5c83f.title: Manager, Claims Operations
6dc11e9a648ba6a5c83f.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Manager, Claims Operations is responsible for managing the day-to-day operational functions of the Claims Appeals, Claims Medical Review, and Subrogation Teams.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Maintains collective responsibility for the management of services provided by the Claims Appeals, Claims Medical Review and Subrogation Teams. Additionally, responsible for monitoring metrics and operations within these teams
* Responsible for implementing best practices based on company goals
* Identify strategic opportunities based on financial analysis and projections, cost/benefit identification and analysis
* Provide support, guidance, leadership, and motivation to promote maximum performance
* Responsible for preparing reporting and analysis that is consistent with defined standards and processes
* Provide technical guidance to staff on claim investigation, reserving evaluation and resolution of claims
* Partner with analytical team to produce necessary results and trending reports for leadership
* Review high dollar appeals, medical review referrals, and subrogation cases from members, providers, and other entities
* Manage all aspects of the day-to-day operations of claims production
* Interact extensively with various parties involved in the claim process
* Remain current and aware of impact on claims management strategies
* Collaborate with other Claims and business leaders to define and drive enterprise initiatives
* Assist or prepare files for subrogation
* Create an environment that encourages and values the opinions of others and promotes sharing of information and ideas

* Oversee monitoring and tracking of individuals and the unit's performance against established productivity and quality goals and metrics.
* Lead, coach, motivate and develop. Responsible for one-on-one meetings, performance appraisals, growth opportunities and attracting new talent
* Clearly communicate expectations, provide employees with the training, resources, and information needed to succeed
* Actively engage, coach, counsel and provide timely, and constructive performance feedback
* Other duties as assigned

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required

**EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* At least 5 years of TPA or group health insurance experience including at least 3 years at a supervisor level and successfully demonstrated leadership competencies
* In-depth knowledge of Claims, Benefits and administrative skills and processes required.
* Intermediate level work experience with Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, Access, and Power Point software applications
* The ability to easily learn other software and systems
* Must be able to write business correspondence and procedures

**POSITION COMPETENCIES**

* Accountability
* Coaching and Feedback
* Collaboration
* Customer Focus
* Decision Making
* Execution Management
* People Leadership

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

* This is a standard desk job requiring extended sitting and computer work.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Remote

Here at Allied, we believe that great talent can thrive from anywhere. Our remote friendly culture offers flexibility and the comfort of working from home, while also ensuring you are set up for success. To support a smooth and efficient remote work experience, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 100Mbps download/25Mbps upload. Reliable internet service is essential for staying connected and productive.

The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

Compensation is not limited to base salary. Allied values our Total Rewards, and offers a competitive Benefit Package including, but not limited to, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Generous Paid Time Off, Tuition Reimbursement, EAP, and a Technology Stipend.

Allied reserves the right to amend, change, alter, and revise, pay ranges and benefits offerings at any time. All applicants acknowledge that by applying to the position you understand that the specific pay range is contingent upon meeting the qualification and requirements of the role, and for the successful completion of the interview selection and process. It is at the Company's discretion to determine what pay is provided to a candidate within the range associated with the role.

402bbc3a51361aec0c2f.title: National Director, Customer Service
402bbc3a51361aec0c2f.description:
**Company Summary:**

At Young Innovations, we foster a dynamic environment where team members make an impact every day as part of a collaborative, inclusive culture. Together, we serve the dental profession and their patients, united in our mission of achieving a Lifetime of Oral Health™.

We embrace diverse perspectives and encourage bold thinking, challenging traditional approaches with a bias for action. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills or grow your career, Young is here to support your goals and continuous learning. At Young, YOU are at the core of what we do.

**Position Overview:**

Young Innovations is looking for a National Director, Customer Service to build, standardize and lead our customer service function across multiple business units. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can balance centralized standards with the flexibility to support diverse brands, product lines and markets.

* Ensure consistent service quality, efficient operations and a unified customer experience strategy while respecting the unique needs and customer profiles of each individual business.
* Give executive leadership visibility into customer service performance across the entire portfolio and unit by unit, and decide what should be centralized as shared services and what should stay decentralized.

**You’ll like this role if:**

* You are a hands-on leader who balances centralized standards with local autonomy
* You have a clear bias for action and a sense of urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurially minded organization
* You enjoy influencing leaders who are not your direct reports
* You are excited to use technology, including Artificial Intelligence, to modernize how customers are served

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

* Medium sized company – not too big, not too small – just enough to get things done and see your impact.
* Did we say benefits? Full medical, dental, vision, 401k, parental leave, paid holidays, paid time off, short & long term disability insurance, employee assistance program, and more!
* Build and lead a unified customer service function across Young's multiple business units, including initiatives that use Artificial Intelligence to modernize current systems and drive efficiencies.

**Who you’ll work with:**

* Reports directly to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO)
* Partners closely with Marketing, Product Management, Sales and Commercial Excellence
* Works with each business unit's leadership (GMs, VPs or Presidents) to align customer service priorities with business goals

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Strategy & Standardization**
  + Develop and implement a unified customer service strategy, service level standards, and quality benchmarks across Young
  + Create scalable, repeatable processes and playbooks that can be adapted across Young and respect our unique customer base and product/service offering
  + Establish consistent KPIs (CSAT, NPS, first-contact resolution, average handle time, etc.) while allowing for business-unit-specific targets where appropriate
  + Identify opportunities to centralize shared services versus what should remain decentralized
* **Operations & Technology**
  + Oversee selection, implementation, and optimization of customer service technology (CRM, ticketing systems, phone/chat platforms) across Young, prioritizing integration and data visibility
  + Standardize training programs, onboarding, and quality assurance processes across business units
  + Build reporting dashboards that give executive leadership visibility into performance across the entire portfolio, as well as unit-by-unit breakdowns
  + Lead initiatives to implement and modernize current systems leveraging Artificial Intelligence to drive efficiencies
  + Manage budgets across multiple cost centers/business units
* **Leadership & Cross-Functional Strategy**
  + Recruit, lead, and develop customer service managers and teams across Young
  + Build a cohesive leadership structure and reporting hierarchy that spans multiple locations/brands
  + Foster a consistent culture of service excellence while respecting individual identity
  + Manage staffing models, scheduling, and workforce planning across units to optimize coverage and cost
  + Partner with each business unit's leadership (GMs, VPs, or Presidents) to align customer service priorities with business goals
  + Act as an escalation point for high-priority or complex customer issues across the portfolio
  + Report on customer service performance, trends, and risks to executive leadership
  + Lead change management efforts when integrating new business units, acquisitions, or process changes
* **Related Duties**
  + Stay abreast of industry, market, and competitive landscape changes that may impact the business, and develop plans to capitalize on opportunities.
  + Other duties as assigned

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of progressive customer service leadership experience, including at least 3-5 years managing multi-site, multi-brand, or multi-business unit teams
* Experience in a holding company, franchise, multi-brand retail/consumer, or private equity portfolio company environment strongly preferred
* Proven ability to standardize processes across diverse teams while allowing for local autonomy
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence leaders who may not be direct reports
* Excellent creative problem-solving skills with the ability to ideate unique solutions to customer opportunities or concerns.
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal, across all levels of the organization.
* Strong project management skills.
* A clear 'bias for action' and sense of urgency to operate within a fast-paced, entrepreneurially minded organization.
* Demonstrated proficiency in verbal and written communication in English, with the ability to convey information clearly, accurately, and professionally across all levels of the organization.

**Technical Skills**

* Demonstrated proficiency with relevant web/e-commerce tools and platforms (e.g., CRM, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

**Work Environment**

**Remote Environment**

This position is fully remote, meaning you will perform your work from a home office or another approved location rather than a traditional company office. As a remote team member, you will be expected to maintain a reliable internet connection, a productive and distraction-free work environment, and consistent availability during established business hours. Regular communication and collaboration will take place through virtual tools (e.g., video conferencing, messaging platforms, and email), and you will be responsible for staying engaged, meeting deadlines, and participating in team meetings and company initiatives. While the role offers flexibility and eliminates commuting, it also requires a high level of self-motivation, organization, and accountability to be successful.

*Young Innovations, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and E-Verify participating employer.*

088be507f538016e3976.title: Construction Operations Manager
088be507f538016e3976.description:
**ABOUT THE POSITION**

The Construction Operations Manager leads the project management function and oversees the administrative, financial, and client-facing delivery of Mammoth Sports Construction projects from project handoff through closeout. This role manages and develops project managers, establishes consistent project controls, and ensures projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements. The Construction Operations Manager works closely with Business Development, Preconstruction, Design, Engineering, clients, owners, and project teams to support successful sports construction and commercial projects.

**JOB LOCATION**: Denver Metro Area preferred  
**TERRITORY:** Colorado, Wyoming, Utah  
  
**SALARY:** Based on Qualifications and Experience  
**BENEFITS:** Health, dental and vision insurance. 401(k) with employer match. Company-paid short- and long-term disability. Company-paid life insurance. Paid Time Off.

**ESSTENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Planning & Scheduling:**

* Provide operational leadership for active and upcoming construction projects, supporting successful delivery from project handoff through closeout.
* Establish and improve project and field procedures for planning, scheduling, cost control, document control, communication, quality, and safety.
* Work with project managers to review project scope, estimates, contracts, budgets, schedules, procurement plans, and key milestones before and during construction.
* Monitor project schedules and progress across the portfolio, identify issues early, and work with project teams to develop practical recovery and mitigation plans.

**Project Administration, Cost Control, & Client Relationships:**

* Oversee project administration, including owner and subcontractor contract requirements, change orders, submittals, procurement, permits, insurance documentation, correspondence, and project records.
* Ensure project managers understand contract obligations, maintain required documentation, and follow established project controls and procedures.
* Review project estimates and budgets; guide contract buyout, cost control, forecasting, cost-to-complete reporting, and assessment of project profitability.
* Review progress billings for accuracy and timeliness, support collection of owner payments, and monitor financial issues that may affect project performance.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, owners, architects, engineers, vendors, and subcontractors; serve as a senior point of contact for project concerns and escalations.

**Business Development & Pre Construction Coordination:**

* Partner with Business Development and Preconstruction on project pursuits, proposals, presentations, early budgets, and transition of awarded work to the project team.
* Coordinate with Design and Engineering to address constructability, scope alignment, phasing, project requirements, and design questions throughout delivery.
* Provide project delivery feedback that can strengthen estimates, schedules, contract planning, and future project pursuits.
* Build on strong client relationships by recognizing upcoming project needs and additional opportunities, sharing them with the Business Development team, and helping encourage repeat work and referrals.

**Safety, Quality & Risk Management:**

* Identify contractual, financial, schedule, staffing, safety, and quality risks and work with project teams to develop mitigation plans.
* Promote compliance with company procedures, applicable codes, safety requirements, quality standards, and project specifications.
* Escalate significant project issues promptly

**Project Reporting & Closeout:**

* Maintain awareness of major project issues and priorities and review regular status updates with project managers.
* Prepare or review monthly project status reporting, cost updates, contract buyout updates, forecasts, and cost-to-completion reports for company leadership.
* Ensure project records and correspondence are maintained and that closeout requirements, outstanding work, final documentation, and client handoff are completed on time

**Travel & Site Support:**

* Travel to project locations as needed to support teams, meet with clients, review field operations, and address project needs.

7d7c5d5b69864b183aea.title: Leasing Professional
7d7c5d5b69864b183aea.description:
**Summary**: Performs all activities related to leasing apartment homes, resident events, completing the move-in process and lease renewals. Interacts directly with prospective and current residents to achieve maximum occupancy. Generates and handles email/phone calls/tours, leasing apartments, qualifying prospects, preparing lease documentation, completing ALL move-in paperwork and addendums, and assisting with the lease renewal process. Assists residents throughout their residency.

**Essential duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned:

* Sell and close prospective residents on leasing apartments in the Community.
* Promptly responds to phone calls and emails from guests and current residents.
* Reviews unit availability daily.
* Walks standard tour path, vacant apartment homes and make-readies daily to ensure the model apartments and target apartments are ready for show; responsible for maintaining work areas and office in clean and orderly manner; need to have an awareness of the curb appeal of the property.
* Gathers information to learn about local community, surrounding community, and competition.
* Utilizes guest card to ascertain the needs and qualifications of every guest.
* Leads guests to vacant and/or model apartments and discusses the features and benefits that meet the needs of the guests.
* Records all traffic in computer CRM program daily.
* Follows up with each guest a minimum of 4 times.
* Creates applicant files and processes applications within the required timeframe according to SOP.
* Verifies qualifications of applicants.
* Presents all applications to Community Manager for approval.
* Contacts applicants to confirm approval or denial of application within 24 hours.
* Schedules lease signings within 24 hours of approval.
* Ensures that applicants are set up properly in the computer, and that all monies are processed within 24 hours.
* Completes lease agreement and collects rental deposit.
* Inspects condition of premises periodically and arranges for necessary maintenance.
* Participates in any internal or external marketing events as required.
* Assists in coordinating and mailing outreach marketing materials.
* Distributes flyers and letters to residents if necessary.
* Shops competitive properties and assists Community Manager in preparing a market comparison grid.
* Records all resident correspondence and submit to manager for review.
* Assists in promoting Woodmont Properties communities.
* Assists Community Manager with any requested work to be completed on the property.
* Promotes resident retention and Preferred Employer programs.
* Conduct or assist in performing corporate, business, and community outreach to improve traffic and leasing of community including the development of joint marketing programs.
* Maintains courteous communications with residents, applicants, and representatives of other companies.
* Adheres to federal and state Fair Housing Laws.
* Adheres to all company policies.
* Supports team in achieving the goals of the property.
* Maintains a team spirit and works well with the entire staff.
* Maintains a clean driving record to utilize the golf cart on premises, where applicable.
* The workweek is typically five (5) days per week, forty (40) hours per week, and may include Saturdays, Sundays, and at times, late nights past normal business hours of operation.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

**Competencies:** To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

* Sales - Sales, presentation, and closing skills are essential.
* Analytical - Collects and researches data.
* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
* Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.
* Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and gets clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings.
* Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Visionary Leadership - Displays passion and optimism; Mobilizes others to fulfill the vision; Provides vision and inspiration to peers and subordinates.
* Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.
* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.
* Judgment - Displays willingness to make decisions; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process.
* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; uses equipment and materials properly. Maintains a clean driving record to utilize the golf cart on premises, where applicable.
* Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence; Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
* Planning/Organizing - Uses time efficiently; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks.
* Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.
* Quantity - Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly.
* Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.
* Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals.; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

**Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education and/or Experience**

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Sales and/or Customer Service training required.

**Workweek**

The workweek is typically five (5) days per week, forty (40) hours per week, and may include Saturdays, Sundays, and at times, late nights past normal business hours of operation.

**Language Skills**

Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.

**Mathematical Skills**

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

**Reasoning Ability**

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

**Computer Skills**

To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Excel, Yardi and Microsoft Office software.

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

e11e89eec0167fa7a338.title: Fleet Operations Manager (Facilities & Operations Department)
e11e89eec0167fa7a338.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

This position administers the County Fleet program, employee parking, and assists with Facilities Operations. The position requires leadership, managerial discretion, and tact in the face of adversity or criticism, as well as strong organizational skills to ensure the department maintains high levels of efficiency and effectiveness at all times.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

***Essential Functions***

The duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not necessarily limited to:

* Responsible for vehicle acquisition, evaluation, replacement, upfitting, GPS program, licensing, registrations, auctioning, vehicle accidents, insurance claims, fuel cards, motor vehicle records, dispositions, and repair/maintenance programs.
* Develops and implements programs of preventive maintenance pertaining to the County fleet, manages and analyzes operation and maintenance costs for all County vehicles, and evaluates vehicles and recommends their replacement when necessary.
* Maintains a complete, timely, and accurate inventory of vehicles owned and operated by the County.
* Assists in the coordination of annual vehicle acquisitions, including but not limited to taking delivery, managing auto tags, and updating CMMS. Periodically reviews requests from various departments for their vehicle requirements necessary to accomplish their specific responsibilities and converts this information into vehicle specifications for use in procurement.
* Acts as liaison between the department and all customers (internal/external, employee/civilian, service providers) in matters of mutual concern.
* Coordinates and administers the County’s Vehicle Rental Program as defined by policy. Assists the County Controller’s Office in determining appropriate mileage reimbursements where applicable.
* Assists in the development of the annual Fleet budget. Assists in the monitoring of departmental operational and maintenance expenditures to ensure compliance with budget constraints. Conducts cost-benefit analysis of maintaining versus replacement of vehicles.
* Assist with the conditions, parking assignments, policies and procedures, safety, and security of the Services Center parking garage.
* Assist with the assignment of parking locations and the parking program for County employees and visitors.
* Assist with County bridges.
* Manage and maintain highway lighting programs.
* Assist with the coordination and oversight of the Facilities Department.
* Prepare repair/project status reports for the Deputy Director and/or the Director of Facilities & Operations.
* Utilize the Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to input and monitor County operations.
* Utilize County financial systems to procure materials and contracted services when required.
* Available to participate in a 7-day, 24-hour on-call rotation program
* Other duties as required

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in logistics, business administration, automotive technology, or other relevant field.
* Previous coursework in business administration, supply chain management, logistics, and accounting.
* Five (5) years of related experience.
* Considerable supervisory experience at the level of Assistant Manager; any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities.

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong organizational and technical skills of all involved trades.
* Management abilities and the demonstrated ability to appropriately supervise differing or difficult personalities.
* Sound, strategic problem-solving skills.
* Extensive knowledge and work experience in office support services including methods, procedures, and office practices.
* Considerable experience in a fiscal management and administrative capacity.
* Extensive knowledge of data entry, computer operations, and automated/electronic record keeping.
* Extensive knowledge of current trends and technological developments pertaining to vehicle procurement, utilization, operation, budget/cost allocation, and fuel/maintenance
* Knowledge of vehicle specifications and standards.
* Considerable knowledge of the English language, including correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
* Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously, maintain project schedules, and consistently meet deadlines.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with associates, subordinates, and outside agencies.
* Ability to adhere to all County policies and procedures, and appropriately engage services provided by other County departments.
* Ability to analyze problems and communicate with the public, staff, and other department heads in a prompt and courteous manner.
* Ability to organize department staff and develop effective work methods.
* General knowledge of financial accounting practices gained through work experience and County preferred practices.
* Ability to type accurately and to compose effective correspondence.
* Ability to handle stress.
* Physical presence in the Facilities is required.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

Ability to sit and stand for extended periods. Work involves sitting, standing, walking, talking, hearing, using hands to handle and feel objects, tools or controls. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. The employee must have the ability to lift and/or move objects up to 25 lbs. The manager may be required to inspect work sites in all extreme weather (hot and cold). The inspections may be for extended periods. The incumbent must be able to operate a County vehicle (automobile or truck). May occasionally wear heavy/hot protective gear (safety vest, hard hat, hearing and eye protection, masks and steel toe shoes).

**WORKING ENVIRONMENT:**

Position requires work in both normal office and construction or maintenance environments. The position involves travel throughout Berks County. Work may be performed in noisy areas, small spaces, and dirty conditions. May experience extremes of heat and cold during normal workdays. Able to work extended shift(s) during a Facilities Emergency.

*This position description serves as a guideline for communicating the essential functions and other information about the position to the applicant/employee. It is not intended to create a binding employment contract nor cover every detail of the position and may be changed where appropriate.*

  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

  

The County of Berks provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

  

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

  

About Us:

Berks County is a combination of rich farm country, industry, beautiful parks, entertainment, and top-notch educational institutions. Whether you are interested in County services, the availability of our parks, tax rates, or other county information, this is the place to start.

  

Mission Statement:

It is the mission of Berks County government and all County employees to administer and deliver services to the citizens of the County in the most effective, efficient and professional manner possible within the constraints of the financial resources available.

75ded4659c7cebd5da4f.title: Vendor Manager
75ded4659c7cebd5da4f.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**Summary**

The Vendor Manager - Critical Environments is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and optimizing strategic relationships with third-party vendors and service providers. In conjunction with the Customer's Facilities Manager, the Vendor Manager serves as the primary point of contact for vendors, leading performance management, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role maintains regular communication to address issues, discuss and track performance (including Work Order completion), identify improvement opportunities, and verify and ensure accurate billing and invoice justification based on Corrigo and process payments. The key to success in this role is to be an open, transparent and consistent communicator to all stakeholders. In this role, you have the opportunity to shape a portion of the digital economy as well as the careers and lives of the teams supporting operations.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Task will include but not be limited to:

* Lead weekly meetings with the client’s Operations teams to review vendor performance, address administrative and operational challenges, resolve outstanding issues, and drive accountability for corrective actions.
* Maintain consistent, proactive communication with the client’s Operations teams to identify emerging concerns, provide updates on vendor-related matters, and ensure alignment between vendor management initiatives and operational priorities.
* Establish, maintain, and optimize strategic relationships with third-party vendors and service providers supporting all data center systems including fire/life safety, mechanical, electrical, cabling, critical environments, and digital systems.
* Serve as primary point of contact for all vendors working within assigned facilities.
* Lead vendor performance management, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor vendor compliance with contractual obligations, service level agreements, and performance standards.
* Track and analyze vendor performance including Work Order completion rates, response times, and quality of service.
* Maintain regular communication with vendors to address issues, discuss performance, and identify improvement opportunities.

3f6a2802d7c185658204.description:
**Overview**
------------

We are seeking a **Senior Industrial Architect** to join our team in ***Exton, PA****.*

This position is expected to work in the office a minimum of three days per week, with project travel as required. The successful candidate will be a highly experienced industrial architect with extensive expertise in the planning, design, and delivery of cleanroom and controlled-environment facilities. This individual will serve as a technical leader, trusted advisor, and project architect responsible for developing innovative facility solutions that meet operational, regulatory, quality, and safety requirements while supporting client business objectives.

This position is intended for a Senior Principal/Subject Matter Expert/Technical Director-level professional with demonstrated leadership in cleanroom and advanced manufacturing facility design.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead architectural design, planning, and execution of large-scale industrial and manufacturing facilities.
* Develop facility concepts, programming, master plans, feasibility studies, and basis-of-design documentation.
* Provide architectural leadership for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities; biotechnology and laboratory environments; semiconductor fabrication facilities (fabs); food and beverage processing plants; cleanrooms and controlled environments (ISO 5-8/Class 100-100,000); and industrial warehouse and production facilities.
* Coordinate closely with process engineering, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, automation, validation, and construction teams.
* Lead development of GMP-compliant architectural solutions for regulated facilities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, industry standards, and client requirements.
* Participate in client presentations, design reviews, and stakeholder workshops.
* Develop architectural standards and design guidelines for cleanroom environments.
* Conduct constructability reviews and support execution planning.
* Mentor junior architects and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Support business development efforts, proposals, technical interviews, and client relationship management.
* Provide technical oversight during procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, and startup activities.
* Review and approve architectural deliverables, including conceptual designs, floor plans, equipment layouts, cleanroom classifications, material and personnel flow diagrams, BIM models, and construction documents.

**About you**
-------------

* Bachelor'S or Master's degree in Architecture from an accredited institution.
* Registered Architect (RA) required.
* Minimum 20 years of architectural design experience for industrial and manufacturing facilities.
* Minimum 10 years of direct cleanroom facility design experience.
* Proven experience delivering multiple projects in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage production, and industrial production facilities.
* Extensive knowledge of GMP and cGMP facility requirements; ISO 14644 Cleanroom Standards; IBC, NFPA, and local building codes; FDA-regulated facility design; and environmental, health and safety (EH&S) requirements for industrial facilities.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams.
* Strong knowledge of architectural detailing for cleanrooms, controlled environments, and critical process spaces.
* Proficiency with Revit, BIM 360, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office applications.

*Technical expertise:*

* Cleanroom envelope design; material and personnel flow segregation; airlock and gowning design; contamination control strategies.
* Clean utility integration; process area adjacency planning; hazardous material classifications; architectural systems for controlled environments.
* Facility master planning; modular and prefabricated cleanroom systems; industrial fire and life safety design; operational readiness and facility startup support.

*Leadership competencies:*

* Strategic thinking and problem solving.
* Client relationship management and executive-level communication skills.
* Technical leadership, mentoring, and staff development.
* Design quality management and project delivery excellence.
* Business development and proposal support.

*Preferred qualifications:*

* Experience with major EPCM, engineering consulting, or design-build organizations.
* Experience on projects exceeding $100 million in capital value.
* Knowledge of Annex 1 requirements for pharmaceutical manufacturing, BSL laboratory facilities, semiconductor wafer fabrication facilities, aseptic processing facilities, and advanced therapy medicinal product (ATMP) facilities.
* LEED Accredited Professional (LEED AP) certification.
* Experience supporting global clients and international projects.
* Experience with digital project delivery and BIM execution planning.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

At AtkinsRéalis, our values—Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, and Excellence—are more than just words. They are the foundation of who we are and how we work. These principles shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire us to create an environment where every team member feels empowered to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.

Depending on your employment status, AtkinsRéalis benefits may include medical, dental, vision, company-paid life and short- and long-term disability benefits, employer-matched 401(k) with 100% vesting, employee stock purchase plan, Paid Time Off, leaves of absences options, flexible work options, recognition and employee satisfaction programs, employee assistance program, and voluntary benefits.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

**Additional information**
--------------------------

Expected compensation range is between $150,700- $188,400 annually depending on skills and experience.

**Are you ready to expand your career with us? Apply today and help us shape something extraordinary.**

2829b3d4cc84b27da20d.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager, Axon 911
2829b3d4cc84b27da20d.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**About Axon 911**  
  
Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.  
  
911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

#### **Your Impact**

As a **Senior** **Technical Project Manager**, you'll lead the successful delivery of mission-critical cloud and IT deployments that power emergency communications for public safety agencies across the country. You'll oversee projects from kickoff through go-live, ensuring implementations are delivered on time while coordinating technical and operational resources across Axon 911, our partners, and our customers. Serving as the primary technical liaison, you'll work closely with engineering, product, implementation teams, and public safety stakeholders to scope technical requirements, drive cloud deployments and system integrations, and ensure seamless cutovers into production. This role requires balancing technical expertise with exceptional project leadership, building trusted relationships with customers, and delivering solutions that directly support first responders and the communities they serve when every second matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end deployment of cloud-based platforms, including system configuration, testing, and go-live support
* Collaborate with customers, partners, and internal teams to implement scalable, secure, and resilient IT solutions tailored for public safety
* Create/manage project and technical implementation plans (e.g., infrastructure readiness, data flows, failover testing)
* Coordinate with DevOps, R&D, and Solution Architects to align product capabilities with deployment requirements
* Manage expectations across stakeholders, resolve issues proactively, and ensure milestone delivery
* Facilitate system handovers to customer IT teams and lead onboarding/training where required
* Identify post-deployment support needs and optimization opportunities for add-on services

#### **What You Bring**

* PMP or CAPM certified
* Have 5+ years of experience managing global technical projects, preferably within a B2B SaaS, IT, or cloud services company
* Are experienced in leading cross-functional teams through cloud or hybrid infrastructure implementations
* Possess strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networking concepts, and cloud deployment models (AWS, Azure, etc.)
* Have a proven ability to translate customer needs into actionable technical plans
* Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced startup culture and are confident interfacing with both technical and executive stakeholders
* Are open to domestic travel to support project execution and client success (up to 20% or more)

Nice-to-Haves:

* Experience with ESInet and NG911 i3-compliant technologies
* Familiarity with systems used by PSAPs or other emergency services
* Hands-on experience managing projects involving cloud-native architectures or real-time communication platforms
* Demonstrated ability using AI tools, cross-platform integrations, and innovative tools

#### **Work Location**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates who currently reside in the United States.

#### **Benefits that Benefit You**

* Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs
* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*  
  
**Pay Transparency**  
  
**Axon is a total compensation company**, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The starting base pay for this role is between $100,050.00 in the lowest geographic market and $176,000.00 in the highest geographic market. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors.
  
  
Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings, please visit www.axon.com/careers/benefits.

  

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Important Notes**

*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

*Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.*

*We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.*

*Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.*

*We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.*

Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

Job description:

Clinical Supervisor - Home Health (RN)

Allentown, PA

$78,000 - $80,000 + Bonus | Full-Time | Leadership Opportunity

*Lead from the Office. Impact the Field. Shape Patient Care.*

At 365 Health Services, great patient care starts with strong clinical leadership. As a Clinical Supervisor, you’ll work alongside our Client Service Managers and operations team in our Allentown office - coordinating care across the full continuum and serving as the clinical backbone of our field nursing team.

This is a role for a Registered Nurse who is ready to bring their clinical expertise to a broader stage - influencing patient outcomes, supporting nurses in the field, and building relationships with the providers, insurers, and care teams that surround each patient.

Applicants will need to be actively working as an RN for at least 1 year - if you’re a strong RN ready to grow into leadership, we want to hear from you!

**Why 365?**

* ACHC Accredited agency with a strong reputation for quality care
* Collaborative in-office environment alongside operations and clinical teams
* Meaningful leadership role with real impact on patients and nurses alike
* Opportunities for career growth in a rapidly expanding organization
* Flexible, hybrid-friendly culture - we value your time and trust your judgment
* Diverse patient population: pediatric and adult
* 24/7 operational and clinical on-call support
* A team built on communication, compassion, and clinical excellence

**Position Overview**

As a Clinical Supervisor, you’ll be primarily office-based, working in close collaboration with Client Service Managers and operational staff to coordinate care between our internal team and external partners - including insurance providers, primary care physicians, hospitals, and care coordinators.

You’ll build and manage care plans based on physician orders, conduct patient assessments at least every two months, and join sales visits with managers to meet new patients entering skilled services. You’ll also play an active role in the training and development of our field nursing staff alongside our education department.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate care for assigned pediatric and adult patients from admission to discharge, including comprehensive ongoing assessments at minimum every 60 days
* Collaborate daily with Client Service Managers and operations staff to ensure seamless internal care coordination
* Communicate and coordinate with external providers including insurance companies, primary care physicians, hospitals, and care coordinators
* Develop and manage individualized care plans based on physician orders
* Conduct sales visits alongside managers to newly referred patients entering skilled nursing services
* Supervise, support, and educate field nursing staff - ensuring they feel connected, competent, and backed by the office team
* Partner with the education department on onboarding, training, and ongoing clinical education for field nurses
* Perform on-site supervisory visits to assess patients, families, environments, and clinical caregivers with complete follow-up documentation
* Evaluate quality of nursing practice and identify opportunities to improve patient outcomes and field performance
* Ensure all nursing practice aligns with physician orders, agency policy, and state regulations
* Serve as a patient and family advocate throughout the care journey

**Qualifications**

* Active PA or Compact Registered Nurse (RN) License - REQUIRED
* Diploma, Associate, or Bachelor’s degree in Nursing from a state-accredited RN program - REQUIRED
* Valid driver’s license and acceptable MVR - REQUIRED
* Minimum one year of nursing experience - REQUIRED
* Previous pediatric or home health experience - preferred
* Previous case management experience - preferred
* Supervisory or leadership experience - preferred, but not required

**Skills & Abilities**

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills - comfortable working across internal teams and external stakeholders
* Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage a varied caseload
* Effective problem-solver with sound clinical judgment
* Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure
* Comfortable working with diverse pediatric and adult patient populations
* Knowledge of compliance, regulatory standards, and professional nursing practice
* Commitment to clinical excellence and patient-centered care
* Must read, write, speak, and understand English
* Must maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times

**Work Setting**

This is a primarily in-office role based out of our Allentown, PA location, with flexibility built in. You’ll spend the majority of your time working alongside our clinical and operations team, with periodic field visits for patient assessments and supervisory visits.

* Office-based in Allentown, PA
* Periodic home visits and on-site supervisory assessments
* Occasional sales visits to prospective patients with skilled services
* May include exposure to varied environments, allergens, bodily fluids, or infectious diseases during field visits

**Benefits**

* $78,000 - $80,000 base salary + performance bonus
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Paid training and onboarding
* Leadership development and career growth opportunities
* Supportive, team-oriented work environment

**Join a Team That Values You**

At 365 Health Services, we’ve built something special - a company founded in 2014 by people with over 25 combined years of industry experience, driven by two core beliefs: keeping patients safe and healthy at home, and giving caregivers meaningful, rewarding work.

We’re growing fast, and we’re growing the right way - through strong relationships, great communication, and a relentless commitment to quality. If you’re a Registered Nurse ready to lead, collaborate, and make a lasting impact, apply today and see what sets 365 apart.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

The Senior Insider Threat Investigator develops and executes portions of the enterprise insider threat investigation and analytics program for assigned areas. The role supports complex investigations, analytics-driven risk assessments, and mitigation activities related to insider risks, including data loss, fraud, misuse of systems, and policy violations.  
  
This position requires senior-level subject matter expertise, applying advanced analytical, technical, and risk judgment skills to evaluate highly complex user behavior, support investigative decision-making, and communicate outcomes to investigative, legal, compliance, cybersecurity, and business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develops and expands insider threat investigation knowledge and capability; communicates complex investigative methodologies, findings, and mitigation strategies to investigators, partners, and less‑experienced team members.
* Performs portions of high‑complexity insider threat investigations by analyzing user activity, access patterns, logs, behavioral data, and investigative artifacts to develop timelines, risk assessments, root‑cause analyses, and evidentiary documentation.
* Coordinates required investigative actions and communications in alignment with insider threat response plans and guidance from leadership to mitigate risk, protect sensitive information, and ensure timely, defensible outcomes.
* Supports research and analysis of potential and known insider threat risks, trends, and control gaps across assigned areas; evaluates effectiveness of investigative and monitoring controls and documents results.
* Develops and enhances portions of investigative playbooks, workflows, and response procedures; monitors indicators of insider risk and supports detection, escalation, and containment activities.
* Partners with Cybersecurity, IT, Legal, Compliance, HR, Privacy, and Analytics teams to ensure investigative activities are compliant with regulatory, legal, privacy, and internal control requirements.
* Translates investigative findings and operational needs into recommendations for process, service, and technical improvements to strengthen the insider threat program and overall risk posture.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**
-------------------------------

* 3+ years of experience in insider threat programs, cybersecurity investigations, digital forensics, or risk analytics.
* Advanced knowledge of insider threat investigation methodologies, behavioral monitoring, and forensic analysis techniques.
* Experience with DFIR, SIEM, and investigative analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of regulatory and control frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR).
* Ability to apply data‑driven insights to risk mitigation and program improvement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive‑level reporting.

#LI-JJ1

Cyber Investigations, Data-Driven Decision Making, Digital Forensics, Executive Reporting, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Insider Threat Mitigation, IT Security Operations, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), Penetration Testing, Risk Analytics, Root-Cause Analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Tools, Threat Assessment

Compensation offered for this role is $80,000 – 165,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

* Handle cash management on a daily basis
* Create and verify client performance reports

* Knowledge of equity compensation a plus

* Strong collaborative work ethic, problem solving and proactive approach, ability to demonstrate methods of efficiency and provide recommendations for workflow systems improvement to contribute in a fast-paced performance-driven environment
* Ability to demonstrate achievements and contributions to scaling business
* Polished communication skills and ability to interact professionally with clients and office personnel. This includes both written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently

* Proficient in Microsoft Office; Excel, Word, Powerpoint, Google docs

**Associate Portfolio Manager Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Series 65 License
* CFA preferred but not required

* A friendly professional demeanor and ability to excel in a team oriented environment

e043a0db5dbae3a117db.title: Project Coordinator
e043a0db5dbae3a117db.description:
Overview:

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

The **Project Coordinator** supports Project Managers and cross‑functional teams in the successful delivery of software initiatives. This role is responsible for **project organization, tracking, documentation, and communication**, ensuring that work stays aligned to scope, schedule, and process.

In a fast‑paced software environment, the Project Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping projects running smoothly by maintaining project artifacts, monitoring risks and issues, coordinating meetings, and ensuring accurate, timely information flows between internal teams and customers.

This role is ideal for someone early in their project management career who is highly organized, detail‑oriented, and eager to grow within a technology‑driven organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Project Coordination & Tracking**

* Maintain and update project schedules, task lists, and milestones in project management tools
* Track and update RAID logs (Risks, Actions, Issues, Decisions)
* Monitor progress against plan **and flag risks, dependencies, and delays to the Project Manager**
* Support tracking of change requests, scope updates, and project decisions

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up‑to‑date project documentation and artifacts in designated repositories
* Prepare weekly project status reports and dashboards for internal and customer stakeholders
* **Capture meeting notes, action items, and decisions; follow up to ensure closure**
* **Ensure project records follow established standards and frameworks**

**Meeting & Communication Support**

* Coordinate and support internal and external project meetings
* **Prepare agendas, materials, and presentations for project forums**
* **Distribute meeting minutes and action items** **in a timely manner**
* Serve as a communication bridge between Project Managers, delivery teams, and stakeholders

**Administrative & Operational Support**

* Track team time, allocations, and PTO as needed for project planning
* Support budget tracking and basic financial reporting
* Monitor tickets, defects, and issues in systems such as Jira or ServiceNow
* Assist with SharePoint or project site setup and ongoing maintenance

**Process & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure projects adhere to defined delivery methodologies and governance standards
* Identify opportunities to improve project coordination, reporting, and execution efficiency
* Support audits, readiness reviews, and operational checkpoints as required

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required**

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, or a related role
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a deadline‑driven environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort working with cross‑functional teams in a software or technology setting

**Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS, software, or professional services organization
* Familiarity with project and collaboration tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Salesforce, SharePoint, or similar
* Exposure to Agile or hybrid delivery environments
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
* CAPM from PMI or equivalent certification

**Key Competencies**

* Organization and follow‑through
* Stakeholder communication
* Risk and issue awareness
* Tool proficiency and data accuracy
* Professional judgment and discretion
* Continuous improvement mindset

**Career Growth**

This role provides a strong foundation for progression into:

* Associate Project Manager
* Project Manager
* Program or Delivery Operations roles
* The Project Coordinator gains hands‑on exposure to real project delivery, customer interaction, and enterprise software operations.

**Geographic Responsibility:** Remote, US

**Type of Employment:** Full-time, permanent

**FLSA Classification (USA Only):Non-Exempt**

**Work Environment:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
* Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
* Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
* May require travel dependent on company needs.
