d0bbcc8d7d9571ab02b8.title: Sr. Billing Operations Associate
d0bbcc8d7d9571ab02b8.description:
**About Lyra Health**

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

  

**About the Role**

Lyra is seeking a detail-oriented Billing Associate to support our Health Plan Billing Operations Teams accounts receivable (A/R) function. In this role, you’ll be responsible for performing key billing functions to ensure accurate and timely processing of claim denials and payments from our health plan partners.. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a growing team and develop your skills in a dynamic healthcare environment.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Serve as a subject matter expert in claim denials, payment posting, and remittance reconciliation, independently managing complex queues and demonstrating advanced understanding of workflow optimization.
* Expertly analyze Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and remittance advice (RAs) to identify intricate root causes of denials or payment discrepancies, developing effective resolution strategies.
* Proactively take ownership of complex denied claims, conducting in-depth investigations, independently correcting intricate errors, and ensuring accurate and timely resubmission of claims to payers.
* Independently manage the accurate and efficient posting of high-volume and complex payments from health plans to patient accounts, ensuring precise allocation, thorough reconciliation with bank deposits, and proactive identification of systemic posting errors.
* Expertly identify, analyze, and independently resolve complex discrepancies between expected and actual payments, escalating only the most novel and high-impact issues.
* Lead proactive follow-up on outstanding denials and underpayments through expert utilization of payer portals, sophisticated phone communication, and clear, persuasive written correspondence.
* Independently prepare comprehensive and well-supported documentation for complex appeals based on nuanced denial reasons, demonstrating a thorough understanding of payer-specific appeal processes and regulations.
* Maintain meticulous and expertly organized records of all actions taken within the billing system, ensuring the highest level of data integrity and audit readiness.
* Collaborate strategically with team members to optimize efficient queue management, proactively contribute to the timely resolution of complex billing issues, and serve as a point of escalation and support for junior team members.
* Consistently adhere to and champion established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance guidelines, demonstrating a deep understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices.
* Proactively identify complex denial or reconciliation issues and independently develop potential solutions, presenting well-reasoned recommendations to senior team members.
* Lead the identification of trends in denials and payment discrepancies, proactively proposing and implementing significant process improvements within your area of expertise.
* Provide mentorship, guidance, and support to junior team members, fostering their professional development and contributing to the overall knowledge and skill level of the team.

### **What You'll Bring:**

* A minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare billing, with demonstrable expertise in independently managing complex claim denials, payment posting, and intricate remittance reconciliation.
* Proven subject matter expertise in reading and interpreting complex Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and electronic remittance advice (ERAs) to resolve a wide range of challenging billing issues.
* Comprehensive and in-depth understanding of the complete claim lifecycle, including intricate and nuanced reasons for claim denials, advanced resolution strategies, and payer-specific rules and regulations.
* Extensive experience independently navigating a variety of complex payer portals and utilizing billing software with advanced proficiency for in-depth claim research, accurate high-volume payment posting, and strategic follow-up.
* Exceptional data entry skills with a consistent and verifiable track record of impeccable accuracy in posting high volumes of payments and updating complex claim information.
* Strong attention to detail and highly developed analytical and problem-solving skills to identify subtle and complex discrepancies in payments and intricate denial patterns.
* Outstanding organizational and time management skills, with a proven ability to independently manage complex workloads, strategically prioritize critical tasks, and consistently meet demanding deadlines.
* Highly professional and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly, concisely, and persuasively interact with payers and internal teams at all levels.
* A deep understanding of and commitment to consistently adhering to established procedures and guidelines, with the ability to identify and recommend improvements to existing processes.
* A highly proactive, solution-oriented, and leadership-driven approach to independently identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex billing issues, often anticipating challenges and leading with effective solutions.
* Demonstrated experience in mentoring and supporting junior team members, contributing to their growth and development.

As a full-time Sr. Billing Operations Associate, you will be employed by Lyra Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $68,000 - 103,500. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience and location. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.
  
  
Annual salary is only one part of an employee’s total compensation package at Lyra. We also offer generous benefits that include:
  
  
Comprehensive healthcare coverage (including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life and disability insurances)  
Lyra for Lyrians; coaching and therapy services  
Equity in the company through discretionary restricted stock units  
Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays  
Paid parental leave
  
401K with up to 3% matching  
Monthly tech allowance  
We like to spread joy throughout the year with well-being perks and activities, surprise swag, regular community celebration…and more!
  
  
We can’t wait to meet you.

"We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice. Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR. Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form. This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com. For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice."

1fe4f9ac0fb8c11057ad.title: Operations Assistant
1fe4f9ac0fb8c11057ad.description:
**Employment Type:** Seasonal / Per Diem

**Pay Rate:** $20.00 per hour

**Expected Hours:** Approximately 20–30 hours per week

**Anticipated Start Date:** November 30, 2026

**Anticipated Hiring Decision:** November 13, 2026

**Work Location:** Remote / Work From Home

**Seasonal Employment Period:** December–March

This is a seasonal position, with employment expected to end at the conclusion of the winter season. JMC values its seasonal team members and looks forward to welcoming eligible employees back for future winter seasons based on operational needs and performance.

**About JMC Enterprises**

For over a decade, JMC has specialized in removing dangerous snow and ice from the tops of tractor-trailers across the Northeast before those trailers return to the road. Our mission is rooted in road safety, and our work depends on reliable communication, teamwork, and a strong commitment to supporting our field teams and customers.

**Position Description**

JMC Enterprises is seeking a dependable, organized Operations Assistant to support our winter snow and ice removal operations from home. In this role, you will help our operations team stay informed, organized, and responsive as weather conditions change. You will play a key role in supporting JMC's weather-dependent winter operations, with primary responsibilities including phone support, dispatch coordination, and professional communication with field technicians, customers, and their drivers. Additional responsibilities include weather monitoring, service-related outreach, recordkeeping, lodging arrangements, billing assistance, and reviewing and documenting technician dashcam footage.

This is a seasonal, per diem position with approximately 20–30 hours per week anticipated. Workload and scheduling may vary based on storm activity and operational needs. The ideal candidate is comfortable juggling priorities, working with digital systems, and communicating professionally in a fast-moving environment.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work closely with the Operations Manager, Operations Coordinators and other assistants to plan, support and facilitate trailer-top now removal operations across 14 states.
* Provide professional and responsive phone support, communicating effectively with field technicians, customers, and their drivers regarding service requests, scheduling, and operational needs.
* Support storm planning and preparation through customer outreach, service coordination, and ongoing communication with the operations team.
* Monitor weather forecasts, track developing winter weather events, and accurately update and maintain JMC's weather forecasting tracker.
* Complete accurate and timely data entry while maintaining organized operational records.
* Coordinate and book lodging accommodations for field technicians as needed.
* Review, retrieve, and document technician dashcam footage using Verizon's Fleet Management System.
* Take on additional operational and administrative responsibilities as assigned, demonstrating flexibility, adaptability, and a willingness to support the team wherever needed.

  

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills, including phone etiquette.
* Comfort using computers, online platforms, and digital recordkeeping systems.
* Proficiency using Microsoft Excel.
* Experience using Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Outlook and One Drive.
* Ability to work independently from home while remaining responsive and collaborating with the operations team.
* Dependability, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information.
* Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and weather-driven operational demands, including changing or rotating shift days and times. Flexibility to work weekends as needed.
* A reliable internet connection and a suitable, distraction-limited remote work environment.
* Experience in dispatch, logistics, scheduling, administrative support, or fleet systems is a plus.

**Workplace Culture & Professional Expectations**

At JMC, our culture is built on safety, communication, collaboration, trust, integrity, and a positive, team-first attitude. Our Core Values guide how we work, how we treat one another, and how we support our customers and field technicians.

We expect every team member to communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally; demonstrate accountability and follow through on commitments; maintain confidentiality; embrace feedback; and approach challenges with a positive, solution-focused mindset. Team members must be dependable, adaptable, and willing to step in wherever needed to support the team, especially during fast-paced winter weather operations.

**Ready to Support a Safer Winter?**

We look forward to hearing from dependable candidates who want to make a difference behind the scenes of our winter operations.

JMC participates in E-Verify and uses Form I-9 information to confirm employment authorization in the United States.

08526859152ff22520b5.title: Senior Compliance Analyst - Healthcare Regulatory Compliance
08526859152ff22520b5.description:
Cuvo is building the infrastructure that enables non-physician operators to legally own telehealth brands. We've developed a compliant three-entity MSO framework that solves Corporate Practice of Medicine and Anti-Kickback challenges; the same legal structure used in $150+ billion of private equity healthcare transactions. As we scale our platform to support Brand Partners across all 50 states, we're seeking a Senior Compliance Analyst to ensure our legal framework remains bulletproof as we grow.

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare law, regulatory compliance, and rapid business growth. You'll work directly with our legal counsel, physician leadership, and Brand Partner operations to maintain the structural separation and Fair Market Value principles that keep our entire ecosystem compliant.

**Tasks**
---------

**Regulatory Compliance & Monitoring:**

* Monitor federal and state healthcare regulations affecting MSO structures, Corporate Practice of Medicine (CPOM) doctrine, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, and telemedicine requirements across all 50 states
* Track OIG advisory opinions, CMS guidance, DEA regulations for controlled substances, and state medical board updates
* Maintain compliance calendar tracking regulatory deadlines, license renewals, and credentialing requirements
* Conduct quarterly compliance audits of Brand Partner agreements, IMG structures, and payment methodologies

**Fair Market Value & Anti-Kickback Compliance:**

* Review and validate Fair Market Value (FMV) compensation structures for physician services
* Coordinate with independent third-party valuators to establish and document FMV rates
* Audit payment flows to ensure outcome-independent compensation (prescribe vs. no-prescribe scenarios)
* Document safe harbor compliance under 42 C.F.R. § 1001.952(d)(1) for all MSO arrangements

**State-by-State Compliance:**

* Maintain compliance matrices for CPOM requirements in strict states (CA, TX, NY, IL, OH, NJ)
* Track state-specific telemedicine regulations and physician licensing requirements
* Review state medical practice acts and corporate structure requirements
* Coordinate with state healthcare attorneys on jurisdiction-specific issues

**Documentation & Agreement Review:**

* Review Brand Partner Agreements, Management Services Agreements, and Business Associate Agreements for compliance
* Ensure clinical autonomy provisions are properly documented and maintained
* Audit physician employment agreements within IMG structure
* Maintain compliance documentation library and audit trail

**Physician Credentialing & Licensing:**

* Oversee 50-state physician licensing and credentialing processes
* Track DEA registrations for controlled substance prescribing authority
* Monitor medical malpractice insurance coverage and limits
* Coordinate with IMG medical director on physician compliance issues

**Brand Partner Compliance Support:**

* Develop compliance guidance materials for Brand Partners on marketing claims, HIPAA requirements, and prohibited activities
* Conduct onboarding compliance training for new Brand Partners
* Investigate potential compliance violations and recommend corrective actions
* Provide guidance on structural separation between business and medical operations

**Reporting & Risk Management:**

* Prepare quarterly compliance reports for executive leadership
* Identify compliance risks and develop mitigation strategies
* Maintain compliance metrics dashboard (audit findings, license expirations, agreement renewals)
* Coordinate with external healthcare law firms on complex compliance questions

**Requirements**
----------------

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Legal Studies, or related field
* 5+ years of healthcare compliance experience, preferably with MSO structures, physician groups, or telehealth companies
* Deep understanding of Corporate Practice of Medicine doctrine, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, and HIPAA regulations
* Experience with state-by-state healthcare regulatory variations and multi-state compliance
* Proven track record conducting compliance audits and developing compliance programs
* Strong understanding of Fair Market Value methodologies in healthcare arrangements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration (MHA), Public Health (MPH), or related field
* Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) or Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO)
* Experience with telemedicine regulatory compliance and Ryan Haight Act requirements
* Background working with private equity healthcare transactions or MSO structures
* Experience with physician credentialing and state medical board regulations
* Familiarity with OIG advisory opinions and healthcare fraud enforcement trends

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify compliance risks before they materialize
* Strong analytical skills to interpret complex healthcare regulations and apply to business operations
* Excellent written communication skills for policy development and compliance documentation
* Ability to work cross-functionally with legal, medical, and business operations teams
* Comfort with ambiguity and ability to develop pragmatic compliance solutions in evolving regulatory landscape
* Project management skills to coordinate multi-state compliance initiatives
* Proficiency with compliance management software, document management systems, and Excel for tracking/reporting

**Experience Indicators:**

* Successfully managed compliance programs through regulatory audits or investigations
* Developed and implemented compliance policies that balanced legal requirements with business objectives

Legal Assistant – Legal–Behavioral Health Integration Project (LBHIP)

**Location:** St. Louis, Missouri  
**Position Type:** To be determined  
**Compensation:** Based on experience

About the Program

The Legal–Behavioral Health Integration Project (LBHIP) is an interdisciplinary program that provides legal advocacy and support to individuals experiencing serious and persistent mental illness (SPMI), particularly those involved in the criminal legal system.

Working in collaboration with the Missouri State Public Defender and community behavioral health providers, LBHIP helps individuals navigate complex legal, psychiatric, housing, and social service systems.

Position Overview

LBHIP is seeking an organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support the program's legal and administrative operations.

The Legal Assistant will work directly with the program's attorney to assist with case preparation, client communications, legal documentation, scheduling, and coordination with courts and community service providers.

This position offers an opportunity to gain experience in a unique practice that integrates civil legal advocacy, behavioral health, and social services.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare, format, file, and organize legal documents, correspondence, pleadings, and other case materials.
* Maintain electronic client files and case management records.
* Assist with tracking deadlines, scheduling appointments, and maintaining the attorney's calendar.
* Communicate professionally with clients, courts, attorneys, treatment providers, and community organizations.
* Assist with gathering records, obtaining documentation, and preparing materials for legal proceedings.
* Conduct basic legal and administrative research as directed.
* Support applications and documentation related to public benefits, housing, and other client needs.
* Assist with coordinating client appointments, meetings, and follow-up communications.
* Maintain accurate records of program activities and services.
* Provide general administrative support for the program's daily operations.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize competing deadlines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, and Excel.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Professional, respectful approach to working with individuals experiencing mental illness, disabilities, and other significant challenges.

**Preferred:**

* Previous experience as a legal assistant, paralegal, or in a law office.
* Familiarity with Missouri courts, legal terminology, and filing procedures.
* Experience working with individuals experiencing serious mental illness or involvement in the criminal legal system.
* Familiarity with legal case management software.
* Experience in nonprofit, public interest, legal aid, or social service settings.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is resourceful, compassionate, organized, and comfortable working in an environment where legal and human service needs frequently overlap.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates clearly, follows through on assignments, and understands the importance of treating every client with dignity and respect.

Why Join LBHIP?

This position provides an opportunity to participate in an innovative model of legal services that addresses challenges extending beyond the courtroom.

The Legal Assistant will gain exposure to civil legal advocacy, behavioral health systems, public benefits, housing and placement coordination, and interdisciplinary collaboration while supporting meaningful work with underserved individuals.

Pay: $25.02 - $30.13 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

01fb2e4d018d33da3a9a.description:
**Community Operations Assistant:**

We are a founder-built mental health community and referral platform serving Orange County. We connect therapists, mental health professionals, treatment centers, wellness providers, and community partners through our professional network, directory, membership, resource boards, partnerships, and events.

Our community connects thousands of mental health professionals, agencies, treatment centers, and wellness providers.

**Project Overview**

I'm looking for a reliable, organized assistant to ***help turn ideas into action and keep projects moving from planning to completion***. This role combines part-time operations and administrative support, community marketing, and event coordination.

**Role & Responsibilities**

We'll check in regularly to review priorities and upcoming projects, then work together to ensure everything gets completed on time and accurately.

Responsibilities include:

* **Email marketing:** Preparing and sending Mailchimp newsletters and member communications.
* **Social media:** Creating content, scheduling posts, and engaging with our community.
* **Community operations:** Emailing members, maintaining calendars, posting events, and supporting membership and partnership activities.
* **Administrative support:** Managing tasks, organizing projects, and helping keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.
* **Event coordination:** Supporting the planning, promotion, and execution of community events.
* **Project follow-through:** Keeping track of deadlines, reviewing work carefully, and making sure details don't fall through the cracks.

This role supports our community and business operations, including our professional directory, referral network, memberships, resource boards, partnerships, and events. It does not involve providing clinical care.

**Who I'm Looking For**

I'm looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable **working independently while staying in regular communication with me.**

**The ideal person:**

* Is highly organized, responsible, and consistent with follow-through.
* Communicates clearly and is comfortable with phone calls and texting.
* Takes initiative, asks questions when needed, and can help turn ideas into actionable plans.
* Reviews their work for accuracy before considering a task complete.
* Understands general small-business operations, professionalism, and best practices.
* Has social media experience and is comfortable with email marketing platforms.
* Has an interest in mental health and a genuine appreciation for the work we do.

Experience in the mental health field is a plus, but reliability, good judgment, organization, and strong communication skills are especially important.

**Hours & Communication**

**Expected workload:** 10–15 hours per week

Initially, I need someone available during the California workday so we can communicate regularly and establish a good working rhythm.

We'll start with frequent check-ins, ideally daily, and gradually move to a couple of times per week and eventually weekly as we develop a system that works well for both of us.

**Being reachable by text is essential,** even as routine check-ins become less frequent. A different time zone is fine as long as you're able to accommodate California business hours when needed.

**Start Date & Compensation**

**Start date:** ASAP  
**Hourly rate:** $20–$30, depending on experience

Pay: $25.83 - $30.11 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Our needs vary from week to week and may include newsletters, social media, member communications, event coordination, and administrative projects. Are you comfortable switching between different types of tasks and helping determine what needs attention first?
* Are you comfortable communicating regularly by text and phone calls? This role requires frequent communication initially, with check-ins becoming less frequent as we establish a workflow. Please describe your availability for calls and how quickly you typically respond to work-related texts during your working hours.
* What experience do you have with administrative support, project coordination, social media management, or email marketing? Please briefly describe relevant experience and the platforms you've used, such as Mailchimp, Canva, or social media scheduling tools and what you use to stay organized.

**GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S.**Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans.

**About the Role:**

The Sr. Analyst, Pricing Analytics will use data and insights to create and optimize our drug pricing, develop new business strategies and reporting, and create data-driven systems in order to deepen our pharmacy relationships and maximize our patient savings. We are looking for someone with a comprehensive analytical toolkit and the ability to dive in and help drive optimal decision making across multiple disciplines. At **Core Health & Fitness**, our purpose is to live and share our passion for fitness. We bring innovative health and fitness solutions to the global market with brands like **StairMaster**, **Schwinn**, **Nautilus**, **Star Trac**, **Throwdown**, **Wexer**, **Gym Rax** and we’re still growing. We press into the future of fitness to ensure the creation of quality products and programming that meet the needs of an ever-evolving industry.

At Core we are committed to building an energetic, diverse, and inclusive workspace. We value our differences and see community strength in diversity and representation. We’re always on the lookout for innovators, dreamers and doers who are passionate about fitness and wellbeing. We explore all opportunities to improve ourselves, our business partners, and our communities. If you’re looking for a fulfilling career in helping people, find the best version of themselves, you’ve come to the right place.

We are looking for a **Material Planner** to join our growing organization!

**General Position Summary**

The Material Planner I is an active team member in planning and scheduling the delivery of material from suppliers to each of our global warehouses. This highly tactical position is responsible for monitoring the flow of buy and assembly items, guarantee availability of components in order to avoid material shortages and assist with the management of inventory levels to meet our customer service and inventory targets.

**Essential Functions / Major Responsibilities**

* Perform timely, cost-conscious procurement of production/inventory/MRO items.
* Receive and analyze requisitions to determine quantity, specifications and delivery requirements.
* Assist with analysis when actuals deviate from established plan, including root cause and respective action(s) to correct and/or sustain.
* Provide supply forecasts to suppliers and internal customers.
* Ensure optimal inventory and safety stock levels are maintained for assigned items.
* Maintain proactive shortage identification and management - help flag root causes and corrective actions.
* Expedite deliveries to meet and exceed scheduled critical requirements.
* Maintain material plan at the time fence to ensure continuity of supply.
* Coordinate cross-functionally for solutions when parts cannot be delivered as promised.
* Analyze material and capacity availability to provide customer promise dates for sales orders.
* Maintains item master lead time information, total current demand by product family and priorities for assigned items.
* Interface with required functional groups to resolve challenging delivery requirements.
* Communicate forecasts and replenishment plans to organizational buyers.
* Consistently review open requirements, monitor vendor performance, and escalate when necessary.
* Communicate problems relating to delivery, quality or to stakeholders and resolve in a timely manner.
* Ensure up-to-date ABC classification is maintained for planning, and other key inputs into ERP.

**Specific Job Requirements**

* Maintain product knowledge in terms of options, substitutions, critical functions/components, etc.
* Broad working knowledge and experience with ISO procedures.
* Maintain basic knowledge of supplier processes and capabilities.
* Possess strong customer service orientation and must provide dedicated support of internal and external customer requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate to various audiences effectively.
* Team-oriented and have the ability to work cohesively with others.
* Strong attention to detail.

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* 1-2 years of buying/planning experience
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* APICS (CPIM) or equivalent certification a plus
* Oracle or relevant ERP software experience preferred
* Basic knowledge of supplier processes and capabilities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications required
* Experience in operations, inventory management, MRP and lean manufacturing processes preferred
* Understanding of Kanban and Min/Max systems preferred

* *Sense of Urgency* - Prioritizes well, shows energy, reacts to opportunities, instills urgency in others, meets deadlines.

caff860ede849571e4b4.title: Lead Security Engineer
caff860ede849571e4b4.description:
**Location:**

Remote Position

**Hiring Range:**

$104,200.00 - $155,800.00

**Position Summary**
====================

The Lead Security Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership for American Oncology Network’s enterprise security program, overseeing security tools, configurations, monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, and managed security service partners across a distributed healthcare environment. Reporting to the Director of IT Security, this role leads and develops a team of three security staff, strengthens the protection of patient information and clinical operations, and drives consistent security practices across AON locations.

**Key Performance Areas**
=========================

**KPA 1: Security Engineering, Tools and Infrastructure**

* Own and administer the security technology stack, including SIEM/SOAR, endpoint protection, email security, privileged access management, and secure network access.
* Maintain and optimize Rapid7 InsightIDR, InsightVM and InsightConnect, Bitdefender GravityZone, Mimecast, Delinea Secret Server, and Cato security configurations and coverage.
* Secure Microsoft 365, Azure and other cloud/SaaS environments by establishing configuration baselines and monitoring security posture.
* Manage security tool licensing, coverage, and renewal inputs to maintain appropriate protection and cost-effective utilization.

**KPA 2: Threat Detection, Incident Response and Vulnerability Management**

* Lead security event triage and incident investigations in partnership with the managed detection and response provider; coordinate containment, recovery, and post-incident reviews.
* Oversee vulnerability scanning, prioritization, remediation, and patch management across endpoints, servers, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure.
* Document risks associated with legacy systems and validate compensating controls where timely remediation is not feasible.
* Develop response runbooks, technical standards, and repeatable procedures to support consistent security operations.

**KPA 3: Identity, Access and Security Risk Compliance**

* Strengthen identity and access security through multifactor authentication, conditional access, privileged access management, joiner/mover/leaver controls, and periodic access reviews.
* Coordinate annual HIPAA- and NIST-aligned security risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration tests with external assessment partners.
* Track and drive remediation of assessment findings and security gaps, communicating technical risks and priorities to stakeholders.
* Assess security risks arising from third-party vendors, integrations, newly onboarded sites, and acquired practices.

**KPA 4: Vendor and Managed Security Partner Oversight**

* Serve as the technical lead and primary day-to-day accountability point for managed service and security partners, including ATG and Rapid7 MDR.
* Validate provider deliverables, service quality, investigation work, and adherence to contractual service-level agreements.
* Escalate gaps and coordinate corrective action with internal IT stakeholders and external partners.
* Promote clear documentation, ownership, and communication across security operations and partner workflows.

**KPA 5: Team Leadership and Operational Improvement**

* Lead, mentor, and develop security staff by establishing priorities, reviewing deliverable quality, and building technical capabilities.
* Provide practical guidance during complex security investigations, remediation activities, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve security workflows through PowerShell, Python, and other scripting or automation methods.
* Communicate security risks, operational priorities, and remediation progress clearly to nontechnical leaders and clinical stakeholders.

**Position Qualifications**
===========================

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science or related field preferred.

**Minimum Relevant Experience**

* 8+ years of information security or security engineering experience, including hands-on operation of production security tools.
* 2+ years leading or mentoring security staff.
* Experience overseeing MSP, MSSP, or MDR providers; leading security investigations; and administering SIEM/XDR and vulnerability management technologies.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, and healthcare security frameworks (HITRUST, NIST CSF).
* Practical experience with endpoint, email, network, cloud, and privileged access security, including Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Rapid7 InsightIDR and InsightVM.
* Preferred: Healthcare or multisite provider experience, EHR familiarity (e.g., OncoEMR), and M&A or new-site security integration.

**Certifications/Licenses**

* Preferred: CISSP, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GSEC), CCSP, or Microsoft security certifications.

**Skills**

* Security Engineering
* Incident Response
* Vulnerability Management
* Identity and Access Management

e286ef043b6988f30a1d.description:
**Introduction**

Retina Consultants of America is identifying and evaluating candidates for the position of **Manager, RCM Operations**. This position will report to the Regional Manager of RCM Operations. The revenue cycle manager role is a highly visible and challenging role that will help execute the vision of the company’s long-term and short-term strategy and become an integral member of a dynamic and experienced operational team.

**Our Company**

Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is bringing together national leaders in surgical and clinical retina care. This network comprises preeminent retina research specialists with the common goal of eradicating blindness caused by macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and other retina diseases.

With over 2.3M annual patient visits, more than 300 physicians, and more than 270 locations, Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is the largest retina care provider in the nation.

**Our Mission**

Through RCA’s physician-centered practice management model, physicians continue to drive clinical care and practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise, resources and share best practices.

RCA seeks to expand our mission by partnering with leading retina specialists who are passionate about delivering excellent patient care and participating in innovative research.

RCA has created a business model that enables retina specialists to retain autonomy and ownership, augmented by sharing best practices facilitated through the Medical Leadership Board and executive management support. Practices within the network will continue to drive all clinical decisions and remain highly involved in strategic operations.

**Our Core Values**

· Relentlessly Commit to our Patients, to the Practices We Serve and to Our Mission

· Embrace the Legacies of Our Partner Practices

· Strive for Continuous Improvement Through Education and Research

· Exude Compassion in All We Do

**Position Overview**

The Manager, RCM Operations oversees revenue cycle processes and initiatives for an assigned RCA partner practice and serves as the primary liaison between the practice and RCA. Working with practice leaders, physicians, key stakeholders, and internal departments, this role ensures project milestones, timelines, and performance goals are met.

The position requires deep physician revenue cycle expertise and proven leadership in guiding teams, implementing enterprise initiatives, and improving performance. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, accurate, accountable, and thoughtful, with sound business judgment and a strong commitment to RCA’s objectives.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the back-end billing RCM team for assigned practice(s).
* Be responsible for the RCM cycle on a practice level, including charge billing, payment posting, and AR follow-up.
* Provide revenue cycle management expertise for adoption of enterprise-wide initiatives and support acceleration of revenue uplift.
* Compile, analyze, and report data regarding performance and trends of the practice.
* Use data and operational reporting to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring performance improvement.
* Implement continuous improvements for policies, procedures, and processes to align with RCA “best practices”.
* Manage, train, coach, and develop staff involved in revenue cycle functions at the practice.
* Submit corrected claims, appeals, special projects, etc. as needed.
* Maintain expertise in retina-specific coding and billing.
* Maintain knowledge of and comply with established policies and procedures including government, insurance, and third-party payer regulations.
* Work collaboratively with RCA’s accounting, data, and payor relations teams as needed.
* Work collaboratively with practice staff, physicians, and practice leadership.
* Maintain relationships and oversee projects with practice RCM staff, insurance providers, RCM vendors, and manufacturers.
* Any other project as determined by the Regional Manager of RCM Operations.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Strong physician retina/ophthalmology billing experience required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold team members accountable for performance and results.
* Ability to direct and lead multiple projects concurrently.
* Ability to analyze monthly data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills required, including the ability to organize, analyze, and interpret revenue cycle data and reporting.
* Knowledgeable in defining approach and resource requirements for projects.
* Knowledgeable in provider credentialing processes.
* Strong organizational, customer service, interpersonal, facilitation, communication, and time management skills.
* Outstanding poise in a fast-paced business environment.
* Ability to work both independently and in a team setting.
* Knowledge of ophthalmology copay assistance programs.

· Ability to consistently meet business deadlines.

* Flexibility to travel as needed.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (preference Business or Healthcare Administration) and/or 10 years of physician practice experience.
* **Minimum of 3 years’** experience in a revenue cycle leadership position; ophthalmology/retina experience strongly preferred.
* Experience in providing cross-functional support to a corporate team.
* Billing/coding certification is preferred but not required.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel required (pivots, vlookups)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint) and Microsoft Outlook.
* Experience and ability to navigate practice EHR / PM systems and RCM/data reporting tools (Nextech, NextGen, Tableau, TruBridge/Viewgol experience, a plus).

**Who we are**

Your Buddy Steve's Garage is an independent light-duty auto repair shop in Bensalem. We have 5 technicians and do about $150,000–$180,000 a month in sales, and we're growing. We use Tekmetric with digital inspections and order parts through PartsTech.

The owner is stepping back from daily operations. This job starts at the counter and grows into running the shop.

**What you'll do**

* Write and sell repair orders in Tekmetric at the front or back counter
* Greet customers, review digital inspections, and build and present estimates
* Follow up on declined work
* Keep the board moving: send work to techs, watch billed hours and promise times, and order parts
* Lead the team day to day: hold people accountable, run a short weekly team meeting, and handle complaints and comebacks

**Where this job goes**

As you grow into the manager role, you'll take on:

* Recruiting and interviewing techs and advisors
* Scheduling
* Reporting weekly numbers to the owner: sales, car count, average repair order, close ratio and billed hours

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years writing service in an auto repair shop
* Tekmetric experience is a plus
* Honest selling. You explain findings clearly and you're never pushy. You don't tell a customer "not sure." When the cause isn't confirmed, you recommend the next test.
* You stay calm under pressure and you're organized
* You own problems without being reminded
* Some leadership experience (lead writer, assistant manager or shift lead) is a plus

**Pay and schedule**

* $80,000 starting base salary
* Quarterly bonus on net profit
* A raise and a profit bonus when you're promoted to manager
* Full time, Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Apply on Indeed with your resume. After you apply, Indeed will send you an assessment. **You must complete it to be considered.** We call qualified people within 2 business days.

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

You will build and strengthen key sponsor relationships, guide consultative R&D strategy and program design, and partner with global leaders to proactively identify and resolve barriers to successful delivery. Acting as the primary executive contact for development programs and operational and financial governance, you will create clear accountability across service lines and help deliver a connected, client-focused experience.

Global organizations and regulated industries trust RRD to reduce complexity and drive audience connections across the entire customer journey.

 **Job Description**

We are looking to add a **Project / Process Engineering Manager - Capital Projects and Process Improvements** to the team! This position is responsible for leading the development, facilitation, and implementation of the Capital Equipment and Process improvements for all manufacturing locations company wide. This position will work closely with operations leadership, plant personnel, and continuous improvement teams at both the business unit and corporate level. Responsibilities will also include designing and delivering capital equipment improvements, analyzing processes, metrics and results, and implementing strategies as necessary.

**This position may require travel between 30% to 50% both domestically and internationally.**

**Responsibilities**

* Manage major multi-million-dollar capital projects companywide including equipment research, layout design, identification and comparison of equipment options and configurations.
* Manage the estimating, capability analysis and implementation of equipment additions and improvements.
* Develop, utilize and update complex spreadsheets and project management tools to track assets, capabilities, condition, age and replacement plans across the worldwide manufacturing platform.
* Create detailed models and testing protocols to compare new equipment technologies as they are introduced to facilitate the asset selection process.
* Estimate and manage major facility improvements and upgrades including Power Distribution, HVAC, compressed air, cooling, humidification, structural work and other utility and building infrastructure requirements.

* Roll out existing CI training programs including but not limited to 5S, make a ready reduction, Kaizen, and value stream mapping
* Develop baselines for future comparisons. Work with IT as needed to modify or expand appropriate data to be captured and measured.
* Provide ongoing feedback regarding goals and plans. Oversee the completion, compilation, and analysis of results to ensure effective program implementation.
* Collaborate with others to ensure the applicability and effectiveness of the process and capital improvements across multiple functional areas.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* 5+ years of experience supporting or working in a manufacturing environment.
* Major Capital Equipment Management experience
* Building, HVAC and power system experience
* Capital and general engineering project management experience.
* Print and Packaging experience preferred
* Digital and Offset Printing experience preferred.
* Manufacturing management experience preferred.
* Experienced in the use of CI tools and capable of training others in their use is preferred.
* Microsoft Excel, PPT, proficiency required. Minitab and Project Management software preferred

**Required Skills**

* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Must have excellent change management and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate across multiple functional areas
* Strong coaching and people development skills
* Good grasp of manufacturing processes, operations, and plant key performance indicators
* Self-motivated and driven to achieve results

Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.  
  
In this SAP AI Transformation role, you'll contribute to Agentic ERP transformations that help clients advance toward the autonomous enterprise. Combining SAP expertise with AI-enabled delivery approaches, cross-functional collaboration, and industry insight, you'll help address complex business challenges and create measurable client impact.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 01/15/2027.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte's SAP practice, with a focus on SAP Data and Analytics, you will work side by side with functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact solutions that support Agentic ERP transformations. With Deloitte Ascend™, you'll leverage AI accelerators and SAP capabilities to help clients modernize business processes and advance toward the autonomous enterprise.  
  
This role requires a highly motivated professional who moves with speed and precision, builds practical solutions, and engages confidently with senior stakeholders and delivery teams to help generate measurable business impact.

* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

* Ability to lead projects or workstreams

* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

* Ability to meet deadlines

**Suveto** is a multi-unit business operating in the veterinary hospital industry. Our mission is to provide top-tier veterinary care while optimizing operational efficiencies and cost management to enhance service delivery.

**Suveto** is empowering veterinary professionals to take ownership of their profession for a better veterinary future. We focus on ownership, growth, and well-being for every individual member of the Suveto team. Our corporate team manages the administrative, human resources, accounting, marketing, and other supportive services for the hospitals in our network. We are a rapidly growing and driven group of people that serve our hospitals to allow them to concentrate on providing exceptional customer service and pet care to their clients.

Our team enjoys collaboration and working together to solve issues and create processes and procedures. The work environment can be quiet and focused, but we absolutely know how to have some fun. We are continuing to build a positive and supportive, team-centric atmosphere as Suveto grows.

We are seeking a **Regional Marketing Specialist** to serve as Suveto Marketing's on-the-ground presence across a defined cohort of veterinary hospitals. The Regional Specialist partners closely with an Operations Director and their hospitals, acting as a conduit between Suveto and local hospital brands — building relationships with Practice Managers and Hospital teams, deploying marketing programs locally, capturing field insights, improving customer experience, and ensuring hospitals get the support they need to grow.

This role is field-heavy and travel-forward. The right candidate is energized by being in hospitals, supporting local teams, and translating between what Suveto designs centrally and what hospitals need to execute locally. This is a build-relationships-and-drive-outcomes role.

**This is a remote position, but the incumbent must be local to the Denver, CO or Dallas, TX area. Only candidates within a commutable distance to Denver or Dallas will be considered.**

**Duties/Responsibilities**

***Hospital Relationships & Field Presence***

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with Operations, Practice Managers, Hospital Liaisons, Medical Directors, and hospital teams
* Travel regularly to hospitals in the assigned region for onsite coaching, campaign deployment, and relationship-building
* Support resources for community outreach and customer experience initiatives
* Understand what is happening at the local hospital level — flagging trends, concerns, and opportunities back to the Guide Dog team.
* Be the liaison between hospitals and Suveto Guide Dog initiatives, providing communication and guidance.

***Marketing Execution & Enablement***

* Deploy network marketing programs (promotions, campaigns, lifecycle communications) at the hospital level within the assigned cohort
* Help coach hospital teams on effective use of marketing tools: social posting tools, digital signage, reminder platforms, and online booking, etc
* Coordinate local media and marketing partners to support campaigns
* Support new hospital onboarding and new Practice Manager onboarding to Suveto Marketing systems and standards
* Support hospitals on community engagement and client engagement best practices; equip them with resources and playbooks to activate locally
* Ensure brand consistency and marketing quality across the assigned cohort. Comfortable giving critical feedback on customer experience.

***Operational Partnership***

* Partner closely with Operations Leadership on hospital priorities, growth opportunities, and areas of concern
* Contribute to focus-hospital planning and regular hospital check-ins
* Escalate strategic questions and complex marketing needs to the Marketing Team
* Support the request intake process by helping hospitals scope, submit, and follow through on marketing tickets

***Insights & Field Intelligence***

* Serve as a cross-functional feedback loop back to the Suveto Guide Dog team — flagging hospital issues to the right function (Integrations, Operations, Marketing, IT) so home office can respond quickly

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* HDI Customer Service Representative or Support Center Analyst
* CompTIA A+

**OTHER PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Current VA or other federal Public Trust / Moderate Risk investigation (reciprocity to be confirmed)
* VBMS or VBA claims application experience

**SCHEDULE AND LOCATION**

Remote within the United States; shifts within 6:30 am-12:30 am ET Monday-Friday and Saturday; Sunday deployment testing as scheduled.

Triumph Enterprises, Inc. is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, operating under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system. We price our work based on local market wages, ensuring we fairly compensate our team rather than paying the bare minimum.

**Job Title:** Customer Service Manager

**Business Unit:** Thiochemicals

**Location:** Radnor, PA

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking an engaging and motivated Customer Service Manager to inspire and guide a team responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across high-volume, order-driven processes.

This role sits at the center of our customer operations and is responsible for leading end-to-end order management, strengthening customer relationships, and ensuring a seamless quote-to-cash experience. The position directly supports revenue generation by overseeing transactional order workflows tied to multiple manufacturing sites.

The Customer Service Manager will mentor and develop a team of Customer Service Representatives while managing escalations, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous improvement across systems and processes. This role operates in a fast-paced environment and requires close collaboration with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and shared service teams.

This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical function that directly impacts customer experience and business performance. You will play a key role in shaping team culture, improving processes, and strengthening customer partnerships while developing your leadership capabilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Service Representatives to ensure high performance and customer satisfaction.
* Create a positive, accountable, and collaborative team environment that fosters growth and engagement.
* Conduct regular team and individual meetings to provide feedback, training, and performance management.
* Monitor daily workload and allocate resources effectively based on order volume and priorities.
* Train team members on complaint management procedures, systems, and business processes.

**Order Management and Customer Support**

* Oversee the full order management lifecycle, ensuring accurate and timely order entry and processing (within 24 hours).
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex or high-impact customer issues.
* Provide real-time support on pricing, product availability, delivery schedules, and shipment status.
* Manage complex order scenarios including VMI, consignment, and multiple supply chain models.
* Monitor SAP order flows, troubleshoot lifecycle issues, and ensure proper customer master data and output settings (acknowledgements, ASN, invoices, COAs).
* Oversee debit, credit, and residual transaction processing.

**Business and Supply Chain Collaboration**

* Partner with Supply Chain, Sales, Logistics, Finance, and Credit teams to support business objectives.
* Analyze and report KPIs related to customer service performance (residuals, complaints, adjustments).
* Support accounts receivable and collections activities in coordination with Finance.
* Contribute to forecasting, reporting, and inside sales or import/export processes as needed.

**Networking and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Represent the team in Customer Service Leadership meetings and cross-functional forums.
* Partner with Business Process Optimization teams on Quote-to-Cash, Master Data, and Purchase-to-Pay initiatives.
* Share best practices and help standardize processes across teams and systems.

**Training & Development**

* Support onboarding and continuous learning for team members.
* Attend training on systems, tools, and service protocols and apply knowledge across the team.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and professional development.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Business or Supply Chain.

**Experience, Qualifications & Skills:**

* 5+ years of customer service, supply chain, or related experience.
* 2+ years of leadership or mentoring experience.
* Experience in high-volume, order-driven environments (e.g., VMI, consignment) preferred.
* Strong leadership, communication, and customer management skills.
* Proven ability to manage escalations and build trusted relationships.
* Subject matter expertise in order management and customer operations.
* **Advanced SAP skills required**; intermediate Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage complex orders, troubleshoot issues, and drive process improvements.
* High attention to detail with strong prioritization and follow-through.
* Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
* Commitment to safety, compliance, and teamwork.

e6748a1fd2bc3fa7bb3b.title: Client Success Executive, Implementation and Accounts
e6748a1fd2bc3fa7bb3b.description:
Cuvo Health is an enterprise telehealth infrastructure company. The Company provides healthcare organizations, clinics and consumer health brands with a complete platform for delivering virtual care under their own brand. This includes patient technology, a licensed clinician network, pharmacy fulfillment, payment infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

The Client Success Executive is responsible for the full client lifecycle, from contract execution through launch and ongoing account management. The role is the primary point of contact for an assigned client portfolio. It is accountable for timely launches, service quality, client retention and account growth.

The role reports to the Director of Operations

**Tasks**
---------

**Client Implementation**

* Lead the onboarding of new clients from contract execution through launch, including kickoff, documentation and timeline management.
* Manage implementation workstreams across payment processing, pharmacy integration, platform configuration and clinical onboarding.
* Prepare, submit and manage regulatory and certification applications, including LegitScript, and coordinate responses to reviewer inquiries.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams in Engineering, Operations, Compliance and Clinical to meet launch milestones.

**Account Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for an assigned client portfolio and keep service levels consistent.
* Maintain the accuracy of client pricing, product catalogs and commercial documentation.
* Manage the resolution of client requests related to platform, payment and fulfillment matters.
* Conduct monthly business reviews covering performance, patient volume, retention and growth opportunities.
* Drive renewals, service expansion and portfolio retention.

**Operations and Reporting**

* Maintain current status reporting for all assigned accounts.
* Develop and maintain implementation standards, client communication protocols and onboarding documentation.
* Oversee AI-assisted client support tools to ensure quality and appropriate escalation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Two or more years of experience in customer success, implementation or account management within B2B software, healthcare or healthcare services.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent client implementations against defined timelines.
* Experience with regulatory, compliance or financial documentation, such as certifications, merchant underwriting, KYC, licensing or provider credentialing.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrated accountability for client retention or renewal outcomes.
* Proficiency with Slack, Asana or comparable project management platforms, CRM systems such as HubSpot, and Microsoft 365.
* Availability to support clients across U.S. time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telehealth, pharmacy, healthcare platforms or multi-site clinical organizations.
* Familiarity with LegitScript certification, HIPAA, Business Associate Agreements or high-risk payment processing.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive base salary of $75,000–$100,000, commensurate with experience
* Performance incentive tied to implementation and retention objectives
* Fully remote work environment
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Technology and home-office allowance
* Professional development and a defined path to client success leadership

Qualified candidates should submit a resume and a brief statement describing a client implementation or account they managed and the outcome achieved. Finalists will complete a structured assessment as part of the interview process.

Cuvo Health is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

36a4ca095e4aab07b5d3.title: Neuromuscular Account Manager
36a4ca095e4aab07b5d3.description:
Remote

Commercial – Sales /

Full-Time - Remote /

Remote

  

*Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.*

*As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at* ***ScholarRock.com*** *and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.*

  

**Summary of Position:**

Scholar Rock is seeking Neuromuscular Account Manager to join the sales team. The Neuromuscular Account Manager is critical to the customer engagement strategy with a concentrated focus on healthcare providers (HCPs) as we launch a novel treatment option for individuals living with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) . The Neuromuscular Account Manager will report to the Regional GM.

The ideal candidate will effectively identify, develop, and maintain relationships with physicians, other healthcare stakeholders and treatment centers to properly educate on SMA and help achieve goals and solve problems to facilitate healthcare provider treatment decisions. Furthermore, they will effectively develop collaborative relationships and communicate information across many different internal/external stakeholders to drive alignment on decisions and help remove barriers to access.

### **Position Responsibilities:**

* Drive patient identification and market development for SMA by building and executing against a territory strategy, account and customer specific plans thereby achieving and exceeding sales goals.
* Continuously assesses sales opportunities within markets and accounts to maintain and grow their business.
* Able to effectively prioritize time, activities, and resources to optimize accounts with the most sales potential.
* Educate and connect HCPs to Scholar Rock services.
* Builds and maintains relationships with physicians by maximizing their time through pre-call planning, leveraging insights to tailor a call plan, and conducts post call analysis to continually refine and enhance their approach.
* Proactively builds effective working relationships with internal/external stakeholders; can drive agreement/decisions from multiple stakeholders; can read people’s emotions and flex communication style.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across commercial, compliance and patient care centers to ensure access at site of care and that logistics are in place to administer.
* Can adjust their approach based on different stakeholder needs, concerns, or audience member to drive alignment and meet their work goals.
* Collaborate with key accounts and physicians to build individual account plans on how to approach their customers, achieve sales goals, and maintain relationships in order to maximize sales results.
* Collaborate with key accounts and physicians to drive patient identification through market development and physician education
* Executes promotional programs, in-services, and lunch-and-learns for their territory.
* Determines suitable travel schedule and call plan on a daily/weekly basis to ensure adequate coverage for all key accounts.

### **Candidate Requirements:**

* 8+ years of progressive business experience in the healthcare or biotech industry, account management, sales, and/or field reimbursement. Rare disease/neuromuscular experience is preferred
* A successful track record as a sales representative collaborating with field market access, clinical education, medical affairs and sales operations
* Experienced pharmaceutical professional with a comprehensive understanding of field / patient reimbursement, specialty distribution, patient support services and buy and bill
* Must be comfortable spending 60% of time traveling; some overnight travel required
* Driving is an essential duty of this job; candidates must have a valid driver’s license to be considered

$205,000 - $240,000 a year

*Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees*.

Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

The Retail Service Associate supports the store team in delivering a best-in-class customer experience across mobile, operational, and transactional activities. This role serves as a go-to technical and operational resource, helping to maintain a clean and efficient store environment, and provide exceptional customer support for mobile. RSAs handle mobile activation, education, troubleshooting, and escalations while assisting with operational priorities to ensure that customers leave confident and excited about their Comcast products and services.

**Job Description**

**Primary Responsibilities — Mobile Focused**
---------------------------------------------

### **Mobile Activations & Customer Education**

* Provide a white-glove experience activating new devices or BYOD to the network.
* Guide customers through tablet setup and connectivity options.
* Support activation and pairing of wearable devices for seamless use.
* Educate customers on accessories and add-ons that enhance their experience and drive incremental revenue.
* Demonstrate strong understanding and enthusiasm for technology and act as a go-to resource.
* Demonstrate basic features and capabilities of devices to increase customer confidence.

### **Mobile Escalations**

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex device or service issues.
* Assist customers in securing accounts, replacing lost or stolen devices, and navigating access recovery.
* Use advanced tools to manage escalations.

* Assist customers with transferring contacts, emails, and media.
* Provide password resets with appropriate credential verification.
* Activate and configure SIM or eSIM for device connectivity.
* Perform in-depth diagnostics to identify and resolve issues.
* Process returns or exchanges in compliance with company policies.
* Assist with warranty claims and replacement processes.
* Ensure devices, counters, accessories, and walkways are clean, functioning, and accessible.
* On-Demand Delivery, BAPIS & XM Upsell: Fulfill Xfinity Mobile on-demand deliveries and BAPIS pickups by staging orders accurately, ensuring smooth handoff, and identifying opportunities to upsell accessories or add-ons.

### **Operations**

* Support store resets for proper merchandising and operational readiness.

* Inspect back-of-house to ensure clean, secure, and properly placed inventory.

### **Express Transactions**

* Facilitate quick device swaps for customers.
* Process equipment returns efficiently while ensuring compliance.

* Understand and follow the Comcast Operating Principles.
* Own the customer experience and promote digital options at every touchpoint.
* Be an enthusiastic learner and advocate of Comcast products, services, and digital tools.
* Win as a team through collaboration and openness to new ideas.

* Drive results and operational excellence.
* Foster and support a culture of inclusion.
* Do what’s right for customers, teammates, communities, and investors.
